Amharic: እምቢተኛነታቸውን እየቀጠሉ ሲሄዱ ሩሲያዊ ዶክተር አገኘን።
English: us congressman john peterson who has been championing popes cause says he fears that might be too late for pope.

Amharic: ከዚያም ኢያሱ ወጥታችሁ ምድሪቱን ሰልሉ በማለት ከቤቴል በስተ ምስራቅ በቤትአዌን አቅራቢያ ወደምትገኘው ወደ ጋይ ሰዎችን ላከ።
English: then joshua sent men out from jericho to ai which is close by beth aven and east of bethel telling them : go up and spy on the land.

Amharic: በ2002 ከተራው ህዝብ ተመርጠው ፍርድ የሚቀመጡ 11 ሰዎች ያቴስ ሶስቱን ልጆቿን በመግደሏ እድሜ ይፍታህ እስራት ፈረዱባት።
English: she was not tried in the deaths of the other two.

Amharic: ምክትል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ የምክር ቤቱ ሰብሳቢ ይሆናል፡፡።
English: the deputy prime minister shall be the chairperson of the council.

Amharic: ተስፋ ቆርጬ ነበር ; እሱ ግን አዳነኝ።
English: i was brought low and he saved me.

Amharic: በሚቀጥለው የጥናት ርእስ ይህን እንመለከታለን።
English: we will discuss that subject in our next study.

Amharic: ትንቢታዊ ይዘት ያለው ይህ መዝሙር ግንበኞች የናቁት ድንጋይ የማእዘን ራስ ድንጋይ ሆነ የሚል ሃሳብም እንደያዘ ልብ እንበል።
English: note what else that prophetic psalm said : the stone that the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone.

Amharic: ያእቆብም ለፈርኦን አለው። የእንግድነቴ ዘመን መቶ ሰላሳ ኣመት ነው፤ የህይወቴ ዘመኖች ጥቂትም ክፉም ሆኑብኝ፥ አባቶቼ በእንግድነት የተቀመጡበትንም ዘመን አያህሉም።
English: and jacob said unto pharaoh the days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

Amharic: የዮሀንስ ደቀ መዛሙርትና ፈሪሳውያን ይጦሙ ነበር። መጥተውም። የዮሀንስና የፈሪሳውያን ደቀ መዛሙርት የሚጦሙት የአንተ ደቀ መዛሙርት ግን የማይጦሙት ስለ ምንድር ነው? አሉት።
English: and the disciples of john and of the pharisees used to fast and they come and say unto him why do the disciples of john and of the pharisees fast but thy disciples fast not.

Amharic: ጳውሎስ እንዲህ ያለ ስደት እንደሚያጋጥመው ማወቁ በፍርሃት እንዲርድ አድርጎት ይሆን።
English: did he cower at the thought of being subjected to such persecution.

Amharic: እንዲያውም ሀብታም ሰው ወደ አምላክ መንግስት ከሚገባ ግመል በመርፌ ቀዳዳ ቢሾልክ ይቀልላል።”።
English: it is easier in fact for a camel to get through the eye of a sewing needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of god.”.

Amharic: ደግሞም ከበትር በስተቀር ለጉዟቸው ዳቦም ሆነ የምግብ ከረጢት እንዲሁም በመቀነታቸው ገንዘብ እንዳይዙ አዘዛቸው ; በተጨማሪም ሁለት ልብስ እንዳይዙ ጫማ ግን እንዲያደርጉ ነገራቸው።
English: also he gave them orders to carry nothing for the trip except a staff no bread no food pouch no money in their belts but to put on sandals and not to wear two garments.

Amharic: አስደሳች ትዳር አለኝ ; እንዲሁም ሳይንስ ሊሰጥ ከሚችለው እጅግ የላቀ ተስፋ አግኝቻለሁ።
English: i have a wonderful marriage and a future far better than the one offered by science.

Amharic: ድንጋጌዎቹም “አትውሰድ፣ አትቅመስ፣ አትንካ” የሚሉ ናቸው።
English: “do not handle nor taste nor touch ”.

Amharic: ከዚያም የያህዌ ቃል ለሁለተኛ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሲል ወደ ዮናስ መጣ : ተነስተህ ወደ ታላቂቱ ከተማ ወደ ነነዌ ሂድ ; የምነግርህንም መልእክት በመካከሏ አውጅ።
English: then the word of jehovah came to jonah a second time saying : get up go to nineveh the great city and proclaim to her the message that i tell you.

Amharic: ይህ በህክምናውም ሆነ በንግዱ አለም የሚሰራ አባባል ነው ብሏል።
English: thats a saying in medicine and in business.

Amharic: በለአምም ከአምላክ ጋር በተገናኘ ጊዜ ሰባቱን መሰዊያዎች በመደዳ አቁሜያቸዋለሁ ; በእያንዳንዱም መሰዊያ ላይ አንድ በሬና አንድ አውራ በግ አቅርቤያለሁ አለው።
English: then god got in touch with balaam who said to him : i set the seven altars in rows and i offered up a bull and a ram on each altar.

Amharic: 17 በቅርቡ ምድር ከማንኛውም አገዛዝ በላይ የያህዌን ሉአላዊነት በሚደግፉ ሰዎች ትሞላለች።
English: 17 soon the earth will be filled with those who prefer jehovahs sovereignty over any other.

Amharic: ደስ የሚለው ነገር የአምላክ ቃል የልጁ የኢየሱስ ደም ከሃጢአት ሁሉ ያነፃናል ይላል።
English: happily the word of god says : the blood of jesus his son cleanses us from all sin.

Amharic: በመሆኑም የሞአብ መኳንንት ተነስተው ወደ ባላቅ ተመለሱ ; እንዲህም አሉት : በለአም ከእኛ ጋር ለመምጣት ፈቃደኛ አልሆነም።
English: so the princes of moab departed and returned to balak and said : balaam has refused to come with us.

Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ ቲቶን በተመለከተ ጥያቄ የሚያነሳ ካለ እሱ ለእናንተ ጥቅም አብሮኝ የሚሰራ ባልደረባዬ ነው ; ወይም ደግሞ ስለ ወንድሞቻችን ጥያቄ ካለ እነሱ የጉባኤዎች ሃዋርያትና የክርስቶስ ክብር ናቸው።
English: if though there is any question about titus he is my companion and a fellow worker for your interests ; or if there are questions about our brothers they are apostles of congregations and a glory of christ.

Amharic: ያእቆብ ጰኑኤልን እንዳለፈ ፀሃይ ወጣችበት ; እሱም ጭኑ በመጎዳቱ ምክንያት ያነክስ ነበር።
English: and the sun rose upon him as soon as he passed by penuel but he was limping because of his hip.

Amharic: ፀሎታቸውንና ሞገስ ለማግኘት ያቀረቡትን ልመና ከመኖሪያ ቦታህ ከሰማያት ሆነህ ስማ፤ ፍረድላቸውም፤።
English: then hear from the heavens your dwelling place their prayer and their request for favor and execute judgment for them.

Amharic: የተግሳፅ ወቀሳም ወደ ህይወት ይመራል።
English: and the reproofs of discipline are the way to life.

Amharic: በዚህ ጊዜ ሴት አገልጋዮቹ ከልጆቻቸው ጋር ወደ ፊት ቀርበው ሰገዱ፤።
English: at that the female servants came forward with their children and bowed down.

Amharic: በምንኖርበት አካባቢ የሚታየው የፉክክር ዝንባሌና የአለም መንፈስ ራስ ወዳድ ወይም ሃይለኛ እንድንሆን አሊያም በሌሎች ላይ እንድንሰለጥን ተፅእኖ ሊያሳድሩብን ይችላሉ።
English: the competitive environment in which we live and the spirit of the world might influence us to be egotistical combative or manipulative.

Amharic: አሁን የተፈጠረው ችግር ይሄንን ከሞላ ጐደል መግባባት ላይ ተደርሶበት የነበረውን ነገር ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ የራሱ ችግሮች ይኖሩት ይሆናል።
English: this problem that surfaced now may be an impediment to implement the situations that were more or less agreed upon.

Amharic: የሃሰት ራእዮች ያያሉ ; የውሸት ሟርትም ያሟርታሉ ; ደግሞም ያህዌ ራሱ ምንም ሳይናገር ሉአላዊው ጌታ ያህዌ እንዲህ ይላል ይላሉ።
English: they see false visions and give lying divination and they say : this is what the sovereign lord jehovah says when jehovah himself has not spoken.

Amharic: ፈፅመውም አጠፏቸው ; እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ደብዛቸው የለም ; በዚያ ለመንጎቻቸው የሚሆን የግጦሽ መሬት ስለነበር በእነሱ ቦታ ላይ ሰፈሩ።
English: they devoted them to destruction down to this day ; and they settled in their place because there were pastures for their flocks there.

Amharic: የምናገኘው ውጤት ምንም ይሁን ምን ያህዌ በታማኝነት የምናደርገውን ጥረት ከፍ አድርጎ ይመለከተዋል።
English: rather he treasures our faithful efforts regardless of the results.

Amharic: ከእነዚህ ነገሮች በአንዲቱ በደለኛ ሲሆን፥ የሰራውን ሃጢአት ይናዘዛል።
English: and it shall be when he shall be guilty in one of these things that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing.

Amharic: ናቡቴ የአክአብን ሃሳብ ለመቀበል ፈቃደኛ ያልሆነው ያህዌ የአንድ ነገድ ውርስ ለዘለቄታው እንዳይሸጥ ለእስራኤል ብሄር የሰጠውን ህግ ስለሚያውቅ ነው።
English: naboths refusal was based on jehovahs law to the nation of israel that forbade the permanent sale of ones tribal inheritance.

Amharic: የአሞንም ልጆች ሶርያውያን እንደ ሸሹ ባዩ ጊዜ እነርሱ ደግሞ ከአቢሳ ፊት ሸሹ፥ ወደ ከተማይቱም ገቡ፤ ኢዮአብም ከአሞን ልጆች ዘንድ ተመልሶ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ።
English: and when the children of ammon saw that the syrians were fled then fled they also before abishai and entered into the city. so joab returned from the children of ammon and came to jerusalem.

Amharic: ባለሟሎቹ ከእርሷ የሚጠጡላት ምንጭ ናት፡፡።
English: a spring from which those near to allāh drink.

Amharic: ይህን ማድረግ ቀላል ነው።
English: is that an easy assignment.

Amharic: እምነትን እንዴት አድርገህ ትገልፀዋለህ።
English: how would you define faith.

Amharic: በዚህ ጊዜ እንዲህ አለው፦ “ያደረግከው ነገር ምንድን ነው? ስማ! የወንድምህ ደም ከምድር ወደ እኔ እየጮሀ ነው።
English: at this he said: “what have you done? listen! your brother’s blood is crying out to me from the ground.

Amharic: ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለያህዌ የውዳሴ መዝሙር እዘምራለሁ።
English: i will sing praises to jehovah israels god.

Amharic: ጆሮ አላቸው፤ መስማት ግን አይችሉም፤አፍንጫ አላቸው፤ ማሽተት ግን አይችሉም፤።
English: ears they have but they cannot hear;a nose but they cannot smell.

Amharic: በዚህ ጊዜ ሁለት ጀልባዎች በሀይቁ ዳርቻ ቆመው ተመለከተ፤ ኣሳ አጥማጆቹ ግን ከጀልባዎቹ ላይ ወርደው መረቦቻቸውን እያጠቡ ነበር።
English: and he saw two boats docked at the lakeside but the fishermen had got out of them and were washing off their nets.

Amharic: ምን እንደሚያስቡና ምን እንደሚወዱ ለማወቅ ሲናገሩ አዳምጣለሁ።
English: i listen to what they have to say in order to find out what they think and what they like.

Amharic: ስለዚህ ፈውስ ማግኘት እንድትችሉ አንዳችሁ ለሌላው ሃጢአታችሁን በግልፅ ተናዘዙ ; እንዲሁም አንዳችሁ ለሌላው ፀልዩ።
English: therefore openly confess your sins to one another and pray for one another so that you may be healed.

Amharic: በዚህ ጊዜ ምላሴ ስለ ፅድቅህ ይናገራል፤ቀኑን ሙሉም ያወድስሃል።
English: then my tongue will recount your righteousnessand praise you all day long.

Amharic: ታዲያ አንተ በወንድምህ ላይ ለምን ትፈርዳለህ።
English: but why do you judge your brother.

Amharic: በአጠገቤ ያልፋል፤ እኔ ግን ላየው አልችልም፤አልፎኝ ይሄዳል፤ እኔ ግን አለየውም።
English: he passes by me and i cannot see him;he moves past me but i do not discern him.

Amharic: ትናንሽ ልጆች እንኳ ናቁኝ።
English: even young children despise me.

Amharic: በትንሳኤስ እንደ እግዚአብሄር መላእክት በሰማይ ይሆናሉ እንጂ አያገቡም አይጋቡምም።
English: for in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage but are as the angels of god in heaven.

Amharic: 15. ሰይጣን የማንፈልገውን ነገር እንድናደርግ ሊያስገድደን ይችላል።
English: 15. can satan force us to act against our own will.

Amharic: ማህበረሰቡ እነዚህን ደንቦች መሰረት በማድረግ በገዳዩና በደም ተበቃዩ መካከል ፍርድ ይስጥ።
English: the assembly should then judge between the one who struck him and the avenger of blood in harmony with these judgments.

Amharic: የጌታ ራት ተቋቋመ።
English: institution of the lords evening meal.

Amharic: በሁለቱም ጎን ያሉትን መተላለፊያዎቹን ጨምሮ በጀርባ በኩል ክፍት ከሆነው ስፍራ ጋር ትይዩ የሆነውን ህንፃ ርዝመት ሲለካ 100 ክንድ ሆነ። እንዲሁም ውጨኛውን መቅደስ፣ ውስጠኛውን መቅደስና የግቢውን በረንዳዎች ለካ፤።
English: he measured the length of the building that faced the open area in the rear along with its galleries on both sides and it was 100 cubits. he also measured the outer sanctuary the inner sanctuary and the porches of the courtyard.

Amharic: የይሁዳ ንጉስ አዛርያስ በነገሰ በ39ኛው ኣመት የጋዲ ልጅ መናሄም በእስራኤል ላይ ነገሰ፤ በሰማርያም ሆኖ ለአስር ኣመት ገዛ።
English: in the 39th year of king az·a·riʹah of judah menʹa·hem the son of gaʹdi became king over israel and he reigned for ten years in sa·marʹi·a.

Amharic: 12. ከፍ አድርገን ልንመለከታቸው የሚገቡ ያህዌ የሰጠን መብቶች የትኞቹ ናቸው።
English: 12. what privileges from jehovah should we appreciate.

Amharic: አንተ በእስራኤል ውስጥ እንደ እናት የሆነችን ከተማ ልትደመስስ ትፈልጋለህ።
English: you are seeking to destroy a city that is like a mother in israel.

Amharic: አንድ ባሪያ የብረት ቀለበት አንገቱ ላይ እንዲያጠልቅ ሊገደድ ይችል ነበር ; ከጌታው ጠፍቶ ከሄደ በኋላ እሱን ለባለቤቱ የመለሰ ሰው ወሮታ እንደሚከፈለው የሚገልፅ ፅሁፍ በቀለበቱ ላይ ይቀረፃል ወይም ይንጠለጠላል።
English: a slave might be forced to wear an iron collar with an inscription or a tag promising a reward if after running away he was returned to his owner.

Amharic: እሱም እንዲህ አለኝ፦ “ወደ አንተ የመጣሁት ለምን እንደሆነ ታውቃለህ? አሁን ከፋርስ አለቃ ጋር ለመዋጋት ተመልሼ እሄዳለሁ። እኔ ስሄድ የግሪክ አለቃ ይመጣል።
English: then he said: “do you know why i have come to you? now i will go back to fight with the prince of persia. when i leave the prince of greece will come.

Amharic: ሌላ ምልክት በሰማይ ታየ። እነሆ፣ ሰባት ራሶችና አስር ቀንዶች ያሉት፣ በራሶቹም ላይ ሰባት ዘውዶች የደፋ፣ ደማቅ ቀይ ቀለም ያለው ታላቅ ዘንዶ ታየ፤።
English: another sign was seen in heaven. look! a great fiery-colored dragon with seven heads and ten horns and on its heads seven diadems.

Amharic: ኑ ህዝቡን እንደምስስ ይላሉ።
English: so that the name of israel may be remembered no more.

Amharic: እንዲያውም ብሩህ የሆነውን የወደፊቱን ጊዜ ለማየት እንድንበቃ ይመኝልናል።
English: in fact he wants us to live to see a bright future.

Amharic: ምናልባትም ከልጃቸው ጋር ብቻቸውን በመሆን በተረጋጋና ፍቅር በሚንፀባረቅበት መንገድ ያህዌ ወላጆቹን እንዲያከብር እንደሚጠብቅበትና ይህን ማድረጉ ዘላለማዊ ጥቅም እንደሚያስገኝለት ለልጁ ሊያስረዱት ይችላሉ።
English: perhaps in private they can calmly and lovingly reason with a child explaining that jehovah expects him to honor his parents for his everlasting benefit.

Amharic: ዳዊት ሆይ እንግዲህ የገዛ ቤትህን ጠብቅ ! ከዚያም እስራኤላውያን ወደየቤታቸው ተመለሱ።
English: now look after your own house o david ! with that israel returned to their homes.

Amharic: ሩት ለራሷና ለኑሃሚን የሚያስፈልገውን ለማቅረብ በትጋት ትሰራ ነበር።
English: ruth worked hard to care for herself and naomi.

Amharic: ራስህን ለአምላክ ወስነህ የተጠመቅከው በቅርቡ ከሆነ ከአንተ ይበልጥ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲሰብኩ የኖሩ የያህዌ ምስክሮች ያላቸውን ተሞክሮ ቢያካፍሉህ ደስ እንደሚልህ ጥርጥር የለውም።
English: if you have recently symbolized your dedication to god by water baptism you would no doubt appreciate benefiting from the experience of those who have been preaching longer than you have.

Amharic: ይሁንና ታላቁ መከራ ሲጀምር በምድር ላይ ምን ያህል ቅቡአን እንደሚኖሩ መፅሃፍ ቅዱስ የሚናገረው ነገር የለም።
English: however the bible does not state how many will be left at the time that the great tribulation begins.

Amharic: ቃየን ልጅ ሳለ ያህዌን የሚቃወም ድርጊት እፈፅማለሁ ብሎ ጨርሶ አስቦ ላያውቅ ይችላል።
English: in his youth cain may never have imagined that he would take a stand against jehovah.

Amharic: “‘አመንዝሮችና ደም የሚያፈሱ ሴቶች ሊፈረድባቸው በሚገባው ፍርድ እቀጣሻለሁ፤ ደግሞም በቁጣና በቅናት ደምሽ ይፈስሳል።
English: “‘and i will punish you with the judgments that adulteresses and women shedding blood deserve and your blood will be shed in rage and jealousy.

Amharic: ዜቡልም። እንገዛለት ዘንድ አቤሜሌክ ማን ነው? ያልህበት አፍህ አሁን የት አለ? ይህ የናቅሀው ህዝብ አይደለምን? አሁንም ወጥተህ ከእነርሱ ጋር ተዋጋ አለው።
English: then said zebul unto him where is now thy mouth wherewith thou saidst who is abimelech that we should serve him? is not this the people that thou hast despised? go out i pray now and fight with them.

Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ በአንድ ወቅት ወዳጅነታቸው አደጋ ላይ ወድቆ ነበር።
English: there was a time however when their friendship was in jeopardy.

Amharic: የማህበረስብ አቀፍ ጤና መድህን ብሄራዊ ምክር ቤት በዚህ አዋጅ ተቋቁሟል፡፡።
English: national community based health insurance council is hereby established.

Amharic: እርሻው አረም ወርሶት አየሁ፤መሬቱን ሳማ ሸፍኖት፣የድንጋዩም አጥር ፈራርሶ ነበር።
English: i saw that it was overgrown with weeds;the ground was covered with nettles and its stone wall was broken down.

Amharic: በጠማኝ ጊዜም ኮምጣጤ እንድጠጣ ሰጡኝ።
English: and for my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

Amharic: እነሆ ሶስት ተጨማሪ ነገስታት በፋርስ ምድር ይነሳሉ ; አራተኛውም ከሌሎቹ ሁሉ ይበልጥ ብዙ ሃብት ያከማቻል።
English: look ! three more kings will stand up for persia and the fourth one will amass greater riches than all others.

Amharic: ከድሮ ጀምሮ ይህን አስቤአለሁ።
English: from days gone by i have prepared it.

Amharic: “ያልተቆረጠውን ፀጉርሽን ሸልተሽ ጣይው፤ በተራቆቱት ኮረብቶችም ላይ ሙሾ አውርጂ፤ ይሆዋ እጅግ ያስቆጣውን ይህን ትውልድ ጥሎታልና፤ እርግፍ አድርጎም ይተወዋል።
English: “shear off your uncut hair and throw it away and on the bare hills raise a dirge for jehovah has rejected and will abandon this generation that has infuriated him.

Amharic: የንጉስን ትእዛዝ አክብር።
English: obey the kings orders.

Amharic: ይህን መንፈስ አዳኛችን በሆነው በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አማካኝነት በእኛ ላይ አትረፍርፎ አፈሰሰው፤።
English: he poured this spirit out richly on us through jesus christ our savior.

Amharic: አምላክ ቃሉ ፍፃሜውን እስኪያገኝ ድረስ ሀሳቡን ዳር እንዲያደርሱ አዎ፣ መንግስታቸውን ለአውሬው በመስጠት አንድ የሆነውን የራሳቸውን ሀሳብ እንዲፈፅሙ ይህን በልባቸው አኑሯልና።
English: for god put it into their hearts to carry out his thought yes to carry out their one thought by giving their kingdom to the wild beast until the words of god will have been accomplished.

Amharic: ይህም ከፍተኛ እርካታ የሚያስገኝ ህይወት ለመምራት አስችሏቸዋል።
English: that meant a most satisfying way of life.

Amharic: ከተማዋ በምንም አይነት ዳግመኛ አትገነባም።
English: it will never be rebuilt.

Amharic: ያህዌ እና ኢየሱስ የአምላክን ስም የሚጠሩትን ሁሉ ከዚህ ጥፋት ያድኗቸዋል።
English: jehovah and his son will bring those who call on jehovahs name safely through that calamitous time.

Amharic: እነሱም ያህዌ በሙሴ በኩል ባስተላለፈው ትእዛዝ መሰረት ተመዝግበው ነበር ; የተመዘገቡትም እያንዳንዳቸው በሚያከናውኑት አገልግሎትና በሚሸከሙት ሸክም መሰረት ነበር ; እነሱም ልክ ያህዌ ሙሴን ባዘዘው መሰረት ተመዘገቡ።
English: they were registered at the order of jehovah through moses each according to his assigned service and his load ; they were registered just as jehovah had commanded moses.

Amharic: ኩት ላይ በተደረገው የጨበጣ ውጊያ ሁለት የባህር ሃይል ተዋጊዎች ሲገደሉ አንድ ደግሞ ቆሰለ።
English: two marines were killed and one injured in the close-quarters fighting in kut.

Amharic: ለዚህም በርካታ የተሻሉና ወገናዊነት የሚሰማቸው ግለሰቦችና ፓርቲዎች እንዲወዱደሩ የሚፈልግ መሆኑን በግልፅ እየተናገረ ነው።
English: for this they want as many better individuals and parties who feel their fellow peoples concern and this is being clearly told.

Amharic: ከዚህ ይልቅ በረጋ መንፈስ በጉዳዩ ዙሪያ ማብራሪያ ሰጥቷቸዋል።
English: instead he calmly reasoned with them.

Amharic: እሱ ግን በእድሜ የሚያንሱ አብሮ አደጎቹ የሰጡትን የሞኝነት ምክር ሰማ።
English: instead he followed the foolish advice of the younger men he had grown up with.

Amharic: በግቢ መካከልም እሳት አንድደው በአንድነት ተቀምጠው ሳሉ ጴጥሮስ በመካከላቸው ተቀመጠ።
English: and when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall and were set down together peter sat down among them.

Amharic: የንጉሰ ነገስቱ የክብር ዘብ አባላት ንጉሰ ነገስቱንና ቤተሰቡን ለመጠበቅ ቃለ መሃላ ይገቡ ነበር።
English: the praetorians were under oath to protect the emperor and his family.

Amharic: ያህዌ ነህምያ ላቀረባቸው ፀሎቶች መልስ ሰጠ ; ደግሞም ህዝቡን የሚጠቅም ነገር እንዲከናወን አደረገ።
English: jehovah answered his prayers and directed matters in a way that benefited his people.

Amharic: ያህዌ በነህምያ ዘመን ከምርኮ ተመልሰው ለነበሩት አይሁዳውያን ፀጋውን ወይም ምህረቱን ማሳየቱን ቀጥሎ ነበር።
English: to those repatriated exiles in nehemiahs time jehovah was continuing to show undeserved kindness.

Amharic: ከህፃናትና ከሚጠቡ ልጆች አፍ ምስጋናን አዘጋጀህ ስለ ጠላትህ፥ ጠላትንና ቂመኛን ለማጥፋት።
English: out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

Amharic: 20. የኢየሱስ ትንሳኤ የአምላክን ታላቅነት የሚያሳየው እንዴት ነው።
English: 20. how does jesus resurrection testify to gods greatness.

Amharic: ቃሉም ደስ አያሰኛቸውም።
English: they find no pleasure in it.

Amharic: የኮርማዎችና የፍየሎች ደም ሃጢአትን ማስወገድ አይችልምና።
English: for it is not possible for the blood of bulls and of goats to take sins away.

Amharic: እነሱም በውስጧ ያለውን ሰው ሁሉ በሰይፍ በመምታት ፈፅመው አጠፉ።
English: they struck down everyone in it with the sword devoting them to destruction.

Amharic: እነሆ ከፊታችሁ ነው ያለው ! ፈጠን ብላችሁ ሂዱ በዛሬው እለት ህዝቡ ከፍ ባለው ቦታ ላይ መስዋእት ስለሚያቀርብ ወደ ከተማዋ መጥቷል።
English: hurry now for today he has come to the city because the people are making a sacrifice today on the high place.

Amharic: ሌባ ሲያዝ እንደሚያፍር።
English: like the shame of a thief when he is caught.

Amharic: የጐን ማስታወሻ፦ ሙአዊያ ቢን አቢ ሱፍያን በሰባተኛው ምእተ ኣመት የሲሪያ ገዥ የነበረና ካሊፍ ኦትማን ከተገደለ በኋላ ኢማም አሊ ቢን አቢ ታሊብን /የመሀመድ አማችን/ በግዛቱ ላይ እንዳለ የተዋጋ ነበር።
English: sidenote: muawiya bin abi sufyan was the governor of syria during the 7th century and he fought imam ali bin abi talib over the caliphate after the assassination of caliph othman.

Amharic: በእሱም ላይ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የሚታየውን የድንጋይ ቁልል ከመሩበት። በዚህ ጊዜ የይሆዋ ታላቅ ቁጣ በረደ። የዚያ ቦታ ስም እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የአኮር ሸለቆ የሚባለው በዚህ የተነሳ ነው።
English: and they raised a huge pile of stones over him that remains to this day. at this jehovah’s hot anger subsided. that is why the name of that place is valley of aʹchor to this day.

Amharic: የቢራቢሮ ክንፍ በዝግመተ ለውጥ የተገኘ ነው።
English: did the butterflys wing come about by evolution.

Amharic: ቃሉን በማወድሰው አምላክ፣አዎ፣ በአምላክ እታመናለሁ፤ አልፈራም። ሰው ምን ሊያደርገኝ ይችላል።
English: in god-whose word i praise-in god i put my trust; i am not afraid. what can mere man do to me.

Amharic: ኢየሱስ በእርግጥ ክርስቶስ እንደሆነ የሚያምን ሁሉ ከአምላክ ተወልዷል ; አባቱን የሚወድ ሁሉ ደግሞ ከእሱ የተወለደውንም ይወዳል።
English: everyone who believes that jesus is the christ has been born from god and everyone who loves the one who caused to be born loves him who has been born from that one.

Amharic: ኢየሱስ የተናገራቸውን ጥበብ ያዘሉ ምክሮች የምንከተል ከሆነ ህይወታችን ደስታና እርካታ የሞላበት ይሆናል።
English: if we follow jesus wise advice we will find happiness and contentment in life.

Amharic: ልጄ ሆይ ቃሌን ብትቀበልና።
English: my son if you accept my sayings.

Amharic: የእግዚአብሄር ምስክር የታመነ ነው፤ ህፃናትን ጠቢባን ያደርጋል።
English: the law of the lord is perfect converting the soul: the testimony of the lord is sure making wise the simple.

Amharic: በአምላክ ፈቃድ የክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ሀዋርያ ከሆነው ከጳውሎስ፣ በኤፌሶን ላሉ ከክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ጋር አንድነት ላላቸው ታማኝ የሆኑ ቅዱሳን፦።
English: paul an apostle of christ jesus through god’s will to the holy ones who are in ephʹe·sus and are faithful in union with christ jesus.

Amharic: በመላው ኤዶም የጦር ሰፈሮችን ከማቋቋሙም ሌላ ኤዶማውያን ሁሉ የዳዊት አገልጋዮች ሆኑ።
English: in all edom he established garrisons and all the edomites became davids servants.

Amharic: እንዲህ የሚሰማት መሆኑ ስህተት ባይሆንም ይህ ስሜት የማመዛዘን ችሎታዋን እንዲጋርድባት አልፈቀደችም።
English: but as we shall see she did not let her feelings which were by no means bad override her good judgment.

Amharic: በህይወት ተርፈው ጢሮስንና ሲዶናን የሚረዱትን ሁሉ ያስወግዳል።
English: it will cut off from tyre and sidon every remaining ally.

Amharic: እኔም እወርዳለሁ፥ በዚያም እነጋገርሃለሁ፥ በአንተ ካለውም መንፈስ ወስጄ በእነርሱ ላይ አደርገዋለሁ፤ አንተም ብቻ እንዳትሸከም የህዝቡን ሸክም ከአንተ ጋር ይሸከማሉ።
English: and i will come down and talk with thee there: and i will take of the spirit which is upon thee and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee that thou bear it not thyself alone.

Amharic: በዚህ አንቀፅ ንኡስ አንቀፅ ፩ ከተጠቀሱት አገልግሎቶች ውጪ ማንኛውንም ሌላ አገልግሎት መስጠት አይችልም፡፡።
English: any paralegal shall not give any service other than described under sub-article 1 of this article.

Amharic: በከተማቸውም ዙሪያ ያለችው መሰምርያ የዘላለም ርስታቸው ናትና አትሸጥም።
English: but the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

Amharic: የአሮን ልጅ፣ የአልኣዛር ልጅ ፊንሃስም በዚያ ዘመን በታቦቱ ፊት ያገለግል ነበር። እነሱም “ወንድሞቻችንን የቢንያምን ሰዎች ለመውጋት እንደገና እንውጣ ወይስ እንቅር?” ሲሉ ጠየቁ። ይሆዋም “በነገው እለት እነሱን በእጃችሁ አሳልፌ ስለምሰጣችሁ ውጡ” በማለት መለሰላቸው።
English: now phinʹe·has the son of el·e·aʹzar the son of aaron was ministering before it in those days. they asked: “should we go out yet again to battle against our brothers the men of benjamin or should we stop?” jehovah replied: “go up because tomorrow i will give them into your hand.”.

Amharic: በሌላ በኩል በደቡብ ኤርትራ ከምትገኘው ፆረና በሶስት የተባበሩት መንግስታት ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ ጉዳይ ያደረሰው ፈንጂ ኢትዮጵያ የቀበረችው ነው በማለት የኤርትራ ሬዲዮ ላስተላለፈው ሪፖርት በሰጡት ምላሽ የካናዳ ሰላም አስከባሪዎችን ያቆሰለውን ፈንጂ ለጊዜው የትኛው ወገን እንደቀበረው ተልእኮው ማረጋገጥ አልቻለም ብለዋል።
English: on the other hand with regards to the bomb blast at the eritreans tsorena on three united nations vehicles that injured canadian peace forces and as to the claim eritrean radio broadcasted accusing ethiopia for planting it he replied for the time being the mission could not prove which side planted the bomb.

Amharic: ሰለሞንም በያህዌ ፊት መጥፎ የሆነውን ነገር አደረገ ; አባቱ ዳዊት እንዳደረገው ያህዌን ሙሉ በሙሉ አልተከተለም።
English: and solomon did what was bad in the eyes of jehovah and he did not follow jehovah completely as david his father had done.

Amharic: እርሱም። እናንተስ እኔን ማን እንደ ሆንሁ ትላላችሁ? አላቸው።
English: he saith unto them but whom say ye that i am.

Amharic: የሚያሳዝነው ግን በዚህ ውብ ሃሳብ ጠለላነት በህዝብ መካከል ጥላቻ ሲነዛ በግርግሩም ብዙ የሚባልለት ህዝብ ሳይሆን ጥቂቶች ተጠቃሚ ሲሆኑ ነው።
English: what is saddening however is the diffusion of hatred among people under the cover of this beautiful idea ; in the confusion rather than the people as was propagated the beneficiaries are few.

Amharic: “መከሩ አልፏል፤ በጋውም አብቅቷል፤እኛ ግን አልዳንም!”።
English: “the harvest has passed the summer has ended but we have not been saved!”.

Amharic: ሆኖም ብልፅግናቸው በእነሱ ቁጥጥር ስር እንዳልሆነ አውቃለሁ።
English: but i know that they do not control their own prosperity.

Amharic: በምሳሌው ላይ ስለተገለፁት ሰዎችና ቡድኖች ማንነት እንመልከት ; የሰው ልጅ ወይም ንጉስ የተባለው ኢየሱስ ነው።
English: regarding the identity of those mentioned jesus is the son of man the king.

Amharic: ፍቅርን ተከታተሉ፥ መንፈሳዊ ስጦታንም ይልቁንም ትንቢት መናገርን በብርቱ ፈልጉ።
English: follow after charity and desire spiritual gifts but rather that ye may prophesy.

Amharic: ወላጆቹም እንዲህ ሲሉ መለሱ፦ “ይህ ልጃችን እንደሆነና ኣይነ ስውር ሆኖ እንደተወለደ እናውቃለን።
English: his parents answered: “we know that this is our son and that he was born blind.

Amharic: እነዚህ ሰዎች የመጨረሻውን ፈተና በተሳካ ሁኔታ በማለፍ እንዲህ የማድረግ ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ያሳያሉ።
English: they will have the opportunity to demonstrate their desire to do that by successfully passing the final test.

Amharic: አንዳንዶች በቀይ ስሩ ውስጥ የተቀመጠው ሻማ መንፅሄ ውስጥ የተያዘችን ነፍስ እንደሚወክል ይሰማቸዋል።
English: to some the candle in the turnip represented a soul trapped in purgatory.

Amharic: ሙሴም በዚያ እለት አምላኬን ያህዌን በሙሉ ልብህ ስለተከተልከው እግርህ የረገጣት ምድር ለዘለቄታው የአንተና የልጆችህ ርስት ትሆናለች ብሎ ማለ።
English: moses swore on that day saying : the land on which your foot has walked will become a lasting inheritance for you and your sons because you have followed jehovah my god wholeheartedly.

Amharic: 16 ዴኒስ ሽማግሌዎቹ እርማት እንዲሰጡት ምክንያት የሆነውን የተሳሳተ አካሄድ ማስተካከል ነበረበት።
English: 16 dennis had to change his course turning away from the wrong that required that he be corrected.

Amharic: እኔ ከሱ ቢሮ ስወጣ ለመርማሪው ፖሊስ ሃላፊ ትእዛዝ ሰጠው።
English: when i went out from his office he gave an order to the police.

Amharic: ያህዌ በመቀጠል ኢዮብን እንዲህ አለው።
English: jehovah continued to answer job.

Amharic: 16. ዮሴፍ ምን ግሩም ምሳሌ ትቷል።
English: 16. what good example did joseph set.

Amharic: ስለዚህ እኔ ዛሬ የማዝህን ትእዛዛት ስርአቶችና ድንጋጌዎች በማክበር በጥንቃቄ ጠብቃቸው።
English: therefore take care to keep the commandments and the regulations and the judicial decisions that i am commanding you today by observing them.

Amharic: በአህዛብ ጉባኤ ከፍ ከፍ ያድርጉት፥ በሽማግሌዎችም ሸንጎ ያመስግኑት።
English: let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

Amharic: ብዙዎች ሰላማቸውን እንዲያጡ የሚያደርጉ አስጨናቂ ሁኔታዎች አሉ።
English: anxieties of life rob many of peace.

Amharic: እህቱን ይቅርታ የጠየቃት ሲሆን አቅፎ አባበላት።
English: he apologized to his sister and hugged her.

Amharic: ከዚያም ወንድሞች ስለ እኛ ሰምተው እስከ አፍዩስ ፋሩስና ሶስት ማደሪያ እስከሚባለው ሊቀበሉን ወጡ፥ ጳውሎስም ባያቸው ጊዜ እግዚአብሄርን አመሰገነ ልቡም ተፅናና።
English: and from thence when the brethren heard of us they came to meet us as far as appii forum and the three taverns whom when paul saw he thanked god and took courage.

Amharic: 11 ያህዌ በህይወታችን ውስጥ እንዴት እንደሚረዳንና ለፀሎታችን እንዴት መልስ እንደሚሰጥ ስንመለከት እምነታችን ያድጋል።
English: 11 as we sense how jehovah helps us in life and how he answers our prayers our faith grows.

Amharic: ማንኛውም የማሰልጠኛ ተቋም የስራውን እንቅስቃሴ በተመለከተ በእውቅና ሰጪው አካል ሲጠየቅ ተገቢና ወቅታዊ መረጃዎችን የመስጠት ግዴታ አለበት።
English: any training institution shall submit proper and up-to- date information on its activities whenever requested to do so by the accrediting organ.

Amharic: እነዚህን ውድ ሃብቶች ከፍ አድርገን መመልከታችንን ልንቀጥል የምንችለው በሚገባ ስንጠቀምባቸውና ለእነሱ ያለን ፍቅር እያደገ እንዲሄድ የማያቋርጥ ጥረት ስናደርግ ነው።
English: to hold on to them we must use them well and constantly renew our love for them.

Amharic: ድንገት የሚከሰት የሚያሸብር ነገርም ሆነ።
English: you will not fear any sudden terror.

Amharic: ያእቆብም ራሄልን ሳማት፥ ቃሉንም ከፍ አድርጎ አለቀሰ።
English: and jacob kissed rachel and lifted up his voice and wept.

Amharic: ‘በሰሜን ያሉትን መንግስታት ነገዶች ሁሉ እጠራለሁና’ ይላል ይሆዋ፤‘እነሱም ይመጣሉ፤ እያንዳንዱም ዙፋኑንበኢየሩሳሌም በሮች መግቢያ፣በቅጥሮቿ ዙሪያ ሁሉናበይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ላይ ያደርጋል።
English: for ‘i am summoning all the families of the kingdoms of the north ’ declares jehovah ‘and they will come; each one will set up his throneat the entrance of the gates of jerusalem against her walls all aroundand against all the cities of judah.

Amharic: ዮሴፍ ለ 13 አመታት የዘለቀ መከራ ቢደርስበትም ነገሮችን ያህዌ በሚያይበት መንገድ እንደሚመለከት አሳይቷል።
English: throughout his 13 year ordeal joseph demonstrated that he had jehovahs view of matters.

Amharic: 8 ለያህዌ ጥሩነት አድናቆት እንዳናጣ መጠንቀቅ የሚያስፈልገን ለምንድን ነው።
English: 8 why should we remain alert to the danger of losing our appreciation for jehovahs goodness.

Amharic: ለአብነት ያህል ከታላቅ ደግነቱ የተነሳ እኛን ለማዳን ዝግጅት አድርጓል።
English: for instance his undeserved kindness comes to our rescue.

Amharic: ጠላት በሚማታበት መንገድ መትቼሻለሁና።
English: for with the stroke of an enemy i have struck you.

Amharic: ሆኖም ከሎጥ በስተ ኋላ የነበረችው የሎጥ ሚስት ወደ ኋላ ዞራ መመልከት ጀመረች ; እሷም የጨው አምድ ሆነች።
English: but lots wife who was behind him began to look back and she became a pillar of salt.

Amharic: ታዲያ አዲሶች፣ ወንድሞቻቸውንና እህቶቻቸውን መርዳት አስፈላጊ መሆኑን እንዲገነዘቡ ማድረግ የምንችለው እንዴት ነው።
English: how can we help new ones grasp the importance of helping their brothers and sisters.

Amharic: 16 አንተም ትሁት በመሆን ያህዌን በትእግስት መጠባበቅህ እንዲህ ያለ እረፍት ያስገኝልሃል።
English: 16 you can experience similar comfort when you humbly wait on jehovah.

Amharic: በእኔ አስተሳሰብ ኢትዮጵያ ይህን መስፈርት ታሟላለች ያሉት ሚስተር ኦጂክ ኢትዮጵያ ከሊስቱ እንድትወጣ የሚያደርጋት አጋጣሚ የመኖሩ ሁኔታ የሚታይ አይደለም ብለዋል።
English: in my opinion ethiopia fulfills this requirement and theres no chance that makes ethiopia out of the list he said.

Amharic: ዦአና እንዲህ ብላለች : ሰዎች እውነትን የማወቅ ከፍተኛ ፍላጎት አላቸው።
English: johanna says : people thirst for the truth.

Amharic: በዚያም በፍርሃት ተንቀጠቀጡ።
English: trembling seized them there.

Amharic: በሽምግልና ማገልገል ብትፈልግም አመታት እያለፉ ሲሄዱ እዚህ ግብ ላይ አልደረስክ ይሆናል ; ያም ቢሆን በያህዌ መታመንህን ቀጥል።
English: if you would like to serve as an elder but that has not happened despite the passing of years continue to trust in jehovah.

Amharic: የእውነተኛው አምላክ ቤት መሪ የሆነው የአኪጡብ ልጅ፣ የመራዮት ልጅ፣ የሳዶቅ ልጅ፣ የመሹላም ልጅ፣ የኬልቅያስ ልጅ አዛርያስ፣።
English: az·a·riʹah son of hil·kiʹah son of me·shulʹlam son of zaʹdok son of me·raʹioth son of a·hiʹtub a leader of the house of the true god.

Amharic: ስምህ የተጠራበትን የማደሪያ ድንኳን መሬት ላይ ጥለው አረከሱት።
English: they profaned the tabernacle bearing your name casting it to the ground.

Amharic: የኦሮሚያ ብሄራዊ ክልላዊ መንግስት አስፈፃሚ አካላትን እንደገና ለማደራጀትና ስልጣንና ተግባራቸውን ለመወሰን የወጣውን አዋጅ ቁጥር 1)^3/፪ሺ3 ለማሻሻል አስፈላጊ ሆኖ በመገኘቱ፣ ተሻሻሎ በወጣው የክልሉ ህገ መንግስት አዋጅ ቁጥር #6/፲፱፻፺፬ አንቀፅ #9/3/ /ሀ/ መሰረት የሚከተለው ታውጇል፡፡።
English: whereas it has become necessary to amend the proclamation for the reorganization and redefinition of the powers and duties of the executive organs of the oromia national regional state proclamation no.163/2011 now therefore in accordance with the revised constitution of the regional state proclamation no.46/2001 article 49 the following is hereby proclaimed.

Amharic: ቅጥር በሌላቸው መንደሮች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ቤቶች ግን በገጠራማ አካባቢ የሚገኝ የእርሻ መሬት ክፍል እንደሆኑ ይቆጠራሉ።
English: however the houses of settlements with no surrounding wall should be considered to be part of the field of the countryside.

Amharic: ከጊዜ በኋላ እስራኤላውያን በእሱ በኩል ለሞአብ ንጉስ ለኤግሎን ግብር ላኩ።
English: in time the israelites sent tribute through him to eglon the king of moab.

Amharic: ፍልስጤማውያኑም “ይህን ያደረገው ማን ነው?” ብለው ጠየቁ። እነሱም “የቲምናዊው አማች ሳምሶን ነው፤ ይህን ያደረገውም ሚስቱን ወስዶ ለሚዜው ስለሰጠበት ነው” ተብሎ ተነገራቸው። በዚህ ጊዜ ፍልስጤማውያን ሄደው እሷንና አባቷን በእሳት አቃጠሉ።
English: the phi·lisʹtines asked: “who did this?” they were told: “it was samson the son-in-law of the timʹnite because he took his wife and gave her to his groomsman.” at that the phi·lisʹtines went up and burned her and her father with fire.

Amharic: የያህዌ ምስክሮች የሚያዘጋጇቸው ፅሁፎች ከ 750 በሚበልጡ ቋንቋዎች እንደሚተረጎሙ ታውቃለህ።
English: did you know that jehovahs witnesses publish literature that is translated into over 750 languages.

Amharic: የሚኖሩት ሩቅ ቢሆንም እንኳ እንደዚህ ካሉት ጓደኞቻችን ጋር ግንኙነታችንን መቀጠል ጥሩ እንደሆነ ተገንዝቤያለሁ።
English: i find it is good to keep in touch with them even if they live far away.

Amharic: ከዚያም በድንገት ጓ የሚል ድምፅ ከኋላ በኩል ሰማሁ።

Amharic: ወንድም እንዲህ በማለት ይናገራል : ወደ እንግዶች መቀበያ ክፍሉ ስደርስ በዚያ የምትሰራውን ሴት አለባበስ በመመልከት የየትኛው ጎሳ አባል እንደሆነች ተገነዘብኩ ; እኔ ደግሞ የዚያን ጎሳ ቋንቋ ተምሬ ነበር።

Amharic: እንዲህ ብላለች : በሌላ አገር ማገልገሌ ያህዌ የተለያየ ዘርና አስተዳደግ ያላቸውን ሰዎች እንዴት ወደ ድርጅቱ እንደሚስብ እንድመለከት አስችሎኛል።
English: she relates : serving abroad allowed me to see firsthand how jehovah draws people from all races and backgrounds into his organization.

Amharic: በእነዚህ ርእሶች ውስጥ በርካታ የመፅሃፍ ቅዱስ ባለታሪኮችን እንመለከታለን።
English: in these articles we will discuss several bible characters.

Amharic: ነፍሴን በፆም አስመረርሁአት፥ ለስድብም ሆነብኝ።
English: when i wept and chastened my soul with fasting that was to my reproach.

Amharic: በመፅሃፍ ቅዱስ ውስጥ ኤሽባአል የሚለው ስም በሌላ ቦታ ላይ ኢያቡስቴ ተብሏል ; ባአል የሚለው ቦሼት በሚለው ተተክቷል።
English: elsewhere in the bible the name eshbaal is presented as ish bosheth baal being replaced with bosheth.

Amharic: ከሳኦል አገልጋዮች አንዱ በያህዌ ፊት እንዲቆይ በመገደዱ ያን ቀን እዚያ ነበር።
English: now one of sauls servants was there on that day detained before jehovah.

Amharic: እኔ ጥበብ ከብልሃት ጋር አብሬ እኖራለሁ።
English: i wisdom dwell together with shrewdness.

Amharic: አክአብ የናቡቴን የወይን እርሻ ለመውሰድ ፈለገ።
English: ahab covets naboths vineyard.

Amharic: ኢየሱስንም ባየው ጊዜ እየጮሀ በፊቱ ተደፋ፤ በታላቅ ድምፅም “የልኡል አምላክ ልጅ ኢየሱስ ሆይ፣ እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ምን ጉዳይ አለኝ? እንዳታሰቃየኝ እለምንሃለሁ” አለ።
English: at the sight of jesus he cried out and fell down before him and with a loud voice he said: “what have i to do with you jesus son of the most high god? i beg you do not torment me.”.

Amharic: የይሳኮር ቤተሰቦች እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ከእነሱም መካከል የተመዘገቡት 64 300 ነበሩ።
English: these were the families of isʹsa·char and their registered ones were 64 300.

Amharic: “‘ስለዚህ ሉኣላዊው ጌታ ይሆዋ እንዲህ ይላል፦ “‘ውሸት ስለተናገራችሁና ያያችኋቸው ራእዮች ሀሰት ስለሆኑ እኔ በእናንተ ላይ ተነስቻለሁ’ ይላል ሉኣላዊው ጌታ ይሆዋ።”።
English: “‘therefore this is what the sovereign lord jehovah says: “‘because you have spoken what is false and your visions are a lie i am against you ’ declares the sovereign lord jehovah.”.

Amharic: ሰለሞን በኢየሩሳሌም የሚገኘውን ቤተ መቅደስ የመገንባቱን ስራ በበላይነት የመከታተል ሃላፊነት ተሰጥቶታል ; ይህ ስራ በታሪክ ዘመናት ከተከናወኑት የግንባታ ስራዎች ሁሉ ትልቅ ቦታ የሚሰጠው ነው።
English: solomon was instructed to oversee one of the most important construction projects of all time that of the temple in jerusalem.

Amharic: አንቺ ከእኔ በእድሜ በጣም ታንሺያለሽ ; ነገር ግን በህይወቴ ልማራቸው ከምችላቸው ነገሮች ሁሉ ይበልጥ አስፈላጊ የሆነውን ነገር አስተምረሽኛል።
English: you are a whole lifetime younger than i am but you have taught me the most important thing i could ever learn.

Amharic: ስለዚህ እናንተ በሰይፍ በረሃብና በቸነፈር ለባቢሎን ንጉስ አልፋ ትሰጣለች ስለምትሏት ስለዚህች ከተማ የእስራኤል አምላክ ያህዌ እንዲህ ይላል : እነሆ እነሱን በመአቴና በታላቅ ቁጣዬ ከበተንኩባቸው አገሮች ሁሉ አንድ ላይ እሰበስባቸዋለሁ ; ወደዚህም ቦታ መልሼ አመጣቸዋለሁ ; ያለስጋት እንዲኖሩም አደርጋለሁ።
English: therefore this is what jehovah the god of israel says concerning this city that you are saying will be given into the hand of the king of babylon by the sword the famine and the pestilence here i will gather them together from all the lands where i dispersed them in my anger and in my wrath and in great indignation and i will bring them back to this place and let them dwell in security.

Amharic: ህግህም እውነት ነው።
English: and your law is truth.

Amharic: ቄስ ያደሳ ዱባ የኢትዮጵያ ወንጌላዊት ቤተክርስቲያን መካነ ኢየሱስ ፕሬዚዱንት የአለም ክርስቲያናት ምክር ቤት አባል እና የመላው አፍሪካ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ም/ፕሬዚዱንት ይህን የገለፁት ከፊያሜታ ጋዜጣ ጋር ባደረጉት ቃለ ምልልስ ነው።
English: priest yadesa duba president of ethiopian evangelical church mekane yesus member of the world church council and all african church deputy president disclosed this in an interview he gave to fiameta.

Amharic: ከያህዌ ምስክሮች ጋር እንድትወያይ አሊያም በተባለው ድረ ገፅ ላይ የሚያወጡትን ጥልቅ ምርምር የተደረገበት ሃሳብ እንድታነብ እንጋብዝሃለን።
English: do not hesitate to speak with jehovahs witnesses or to read their careful research on the jw.org website.

Amharic: ሙሴንም። አንተ አሮንም ናዳብም አብዩድም ከእስራኤልም ሰባ ሽማግሌዎች ወደ እግዚአብሄር ውጡ፥ በሩቁም ስገዱ፤።
English: and he said unto moses come up unto the lord thou and aaron nadab and abihu and seventy of the elders of israel; and worship ye afar off.

Amharic: በስራ ላይ የደረሰ የአካል ጉዳት የሚከተሉት ውጤቶች ይኖሩታል፤።
English: disablement means any employment injury as a consequence of which there is a decrease or loss of capacity to work.

Amharic: በውሃና በደም አማካኝነት የመጣው፣ እሱ ይሀውም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ነው፤ የመጣውም ከውሃ ጋር ብቻ ሳይሆን ከውሃና ከደም ጋር ነው። ምስክርነት የሚሰጠውም መንፈስ ነው፤ ምክንያቱም መንፈስ እውነት ነው።
English: this is the one who came by means of water and blood jesus christ not with the water only but with the water and with the blood. and the spirit is bearing witness because the spirit is the truth.

Amharic: ከዚያም ዳዊት በደማስቆ ሶርያ የጦር ሰፈሮች አቋቋመ ; ሶርያውያንም የዳዊት አገልጋዮች ሆኑ ; ግብርም ገበሩለት።
English: david then established garrisons in syria of damascus and the syrians became davids servants and brought tribute.

Amharic: የሚያዩህ አተኩረው ይመለከቱሃል።
English: those seeing you will stare at you.

Amharic: የታጠቁትም ተዋጊዎች ቀንደ መለከቱን ከሚነፉት ካህናት ቀድመው ሄዱ፤ የኋላው ደጀን ደግሞ ታቦቱን ይከተል ነበር፤ በዚህ ጊዜ ሁሉ ቀንደ መለከቱ ያለማቋረጥ ይነፋ ነበር።
English: and the armed troops went ahead of the priests who were blowing the horns and the rear guard followed the ark as the horns were blown continuously.

Amharic: የያህዌን ተግሳፅ አትናቁ።
English: let us not reject the discipline of jehovah.

Amharic: የምስክሩን ታቦት እንዲሁም መሎጊያዎቹንና መክደኛውን፣።
English: the ark of the testimony and its poles and the cover.

Amharic: በተጨማሪም ሙሴ እንደ ፍቅር፣ የዋህነትና ትእግስት ያሉትን ግሩም ባህርያት እንዲያፈራ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ረድቶታል፤ እነዚህ ባህርያት ደግሞ እስራኤላውያንን ለመምራት ብቁ እንዲሆን አስችለውታል።
English: holy spirit also produced in moses beautiful qualities such as love meekness and patience that qualified him to lead the israelites.

Amharic: እኔም የሚጠሉኝን አጠፋቸዋለሁ።
English: and i will put an end to those who hate me.

Amharic: እህት ባለን ህይወት ረክተን እንኖር ነበር በማለት ከጊዜ በኋላ ፅፋለች።
English: the sister later wrote : we had become too comfortable in our routine.

Amharic: በሁለተኛውም ቀን ከተማዋን አንድ ጊዜ ዞሯት ; ከዚያም ወደ ሰፈሩ ተመለሱ።
English: they marched around the city on the second day once after which they returned to the camp.

Amharic: ሚስተር ኖሬጋ ት/ቤት እያለ ግራ አዝማሚያ ካላቸው ጋር በመቀላቀሉ ያገኙት ጉርሻ ለዩ.ኤስ ጥቅም በጣም አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ታመነበት።
English: the woman had nearly died.

Amharic: አክአብ በሰማርያ 70 ወንዶች ልጆች ነበሩት።
English: now ahab had 70 sons in samaria.

Amharic: ሁሉንም የማደሪያ ድንኳኑን ቋሚዎች የሰራው በዚህ መንገድ ነበር።
English: that is how he made all the panel frames of the tabernacle.

Amharic: ይህ ችሮታ ከአላህ ነው፡፡ አዋቂነትም በአላህ በቃ፡፡።
English: that is the bounty from allāh and sufficient is allāh as knower.

Amharic: ሄዶም ሌሎች አማልክትን ያመለከ፥ እኔ ላላዘዝኋቸው ለፀሀይና ለጨረቃ ለሰማይም ሰራዊት ሁሉ የሰገደ ቢገኝ፥።
English: and hath gone and served other gods and worshipped them either the sun or moon or any of the host of heaven which i have not commanded.

Amharic: ሆኖም የክፉዎችን መታሰቢያ ሁሉ ከምድር ለማጥፋት፣የይሆዋ ፊት በእነሱ ላይ ነው።
English: but the face of jehovah is against those doing what is bad to erase all memory of them from the earth.

Amharic: ከግራ ወደ ቀኝ : ማቲ ታኡኖ ሳይሚ ማሪያ ኤሚሊያ ቫይኖ አይሊ እና አኒኪ በ 1935።
English: from left : matti tauno saimi maria emilia väinö aili and annikki in 1935.

Amharic: ለምሳሌ በቤተ መቅደሱ ግቢ ደቡብ ምስራቃዊ ጫፍ ላይ ቆሞ ሊሆን ይችላል።
English: he could have stood for example on the southeastern corner of the temple area.

Amharic: ጥልቅ ማስተዋል ያለው ሰው ወደ መቃብር ከመውረድ ይድን ዘንድ የህይወት መንገድ ወደ ላይ ይመራዋል።
English: the path of life leads upward to one with insight to turn him away from the grave below.

Amharic: እኔም ከዮርዳኖስ አንስቶ በስተ ምእራብ እስከሚገኘው እስከ ታላቁ ባህር ድረስ ያጠፋኋቸውን ብሄራት ሁሉ ምድር ጨምሮ የቀሩትን ብሄራት ምድር ለየነገዶቻችሁ ርስት እንዲሆን በእጣ አከፋፍዬ ሰጥቻችኋለሁ።
English: see i assigned to you by lot the land of the nations that remain as an inheritance for your tribes as well as that of all the nations that i destroyed from the jordan to the great sea on the west.

Amharic: አምላክን እንደሚያውቁ የሚያሳይ ፈጣን ምላሽ የሚሰጥ ልብ ለማግኘት መመኘታቸው አስፈላጊ ነው።
English: they needed to desire a sensitive heart that reflected their knowing god.

Amharic: ከዚያም ወጥቶ ኢዮስጦስ ወደሚባል እግዚአብሄርን ወደሚያመልክ ሰው ቤት ገባ ቤቱም በምኩራብ አጠገብ ነበረ።
English: and he departed thence and entered into a certain man’s house named justus one that worshipped god whose house joined hard to the synagogue.

Amharic: አላህ እነዚያን ያመኑትን በቅርቢቱም ህይወት በመጨረሻይቱም በተረጋገጠው ቃል ላይ ያረጋቸዋል፡፡ ከሃዲዎችንም አላህ ያሳስታቸዋል፡፡ አላህም የሚሻውን ይሰራል፡፡።
English: allāh keeps firm those who believe with the firm word in worldly life and in the hereafter. and allāh sends astray the wrongdoers. and allāh does what he wills.

Amharic: ስሜትህን በፅሁፍ አስፍር።
English: keep a journal.

Amharic: እንዲሁም የሰለሞን አገልጋይ የሆነ ኢዮርብአም የተባለ አንድ ኤፍሬማዊ ነበር ; እሱም ከፀሬዳህ ወገን ሲሆን የናባጥ ልጅ ነበር ; እናቱም ፅሩአ የምትባል መበለት ነበረች።
English: and there was jeroboam the son of nebat an ephraimite from zeredah a servant of solomons whose mothers name was zeruah a widow.

Amharic: ከመካከላቸው ይህን ሊናገር የሚችል ማን አለ።
English: who among them can tell this.

Amharic: ከመዝሙር መፅሃፍ መፅናኛ ወይም ከምሳሌ መፅሃፍ ተግባራዊ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ ትምህርቶችን ያላገኘ ማን አለ።
English: and who among us has not found comfort in the psalms or drawn practical lessons from the book of proverbs.

Amharic: እነርሱም ለኢያሱ እንዲህ ብለው መለሱለት። ያዘዝሀንን ነገር ሁሉ እናደርጋለን ወደምትልከንም ስፍራ እንሄዳለን።
English: and they answered joshua saying all that thou commandest us we will do and whithersoever thou sendest us we will go.

Amharic: ዳንኤልም ወደ መቃብር መሄዱ አይቀርም።
English: daniel would soon be going there.

Amharic: ለአካል ጉዳተኞች በተዘጋጀ ልዩ ተሽከርካሪ ወንበር በመጠቀም የያህዌ ምስክሮች በሚያደርጓቸው አንዳንድ ስብሰባዎች ላይ መገኘትና ከእነሱ ጋር በስብከቱ ስራ መካፈል ጀመርኩ።
English: with the use of a special wheelchair i even attended some meetings of jehovahs witnesses and shared in their preaching activity.

Amharic: እኛም ያህዌን እያወቅነው ስንሄድ ባህርያቱንና ድርጊቱን በልባችን አይኖች ስለምናስተውል በአንድ ጉዳይ ላይ እጁ እንዳለበት ማየት እንችላለን።
English: as we come to know him we too can see his hand because we perceive his qualities and actions with the eyes of our heart.

Amharic: 18 19. ማበረታቻ የሚያስፈልጋቸውን ማነፅ የምንችለው እንዴት ነው።
English: 18 19. how can we build up those needing encouragement.

Amharic: አማትዋም ኑሃሚን አለቻት። ልጄ ሆይ፥ መልካም እንዲሆንልሽ እረፍት አልፈልግልሽምን።
English: then naomi her mother in law said unto her my daughter shall i not seek rest for thee that it may be well with thee.

Amharic: በተጨማሪም ስለ መላእክት ሲናገር መላእክቱን መናፍስት አገልጋዮቹን ደግሞ የእሳት ነበልባል ያደርጋል ይላል።
English: also he says about the angels : he makes his angels spirits and his ministers a flame of fire.

Amharic: ዙፋኑ ከኪሩቤል በላይ ነው።
English: enthroned above the cherubs.

Amharic: እንግዲህ ስለ እነዚህ ነገሮች ምን እንበል? አምላክ ከእኛ ጋር ከሆነ ማን ሊቃወመን ይችላል።
English: what then are we to say about these things? if god is for us who will be against us.

Amharic: እርሱም አለው። እነሆ እኔ ቃል ኪዳን አደርጋለሁ፤ በምድር ሁሉ፥ በአህዛብም ሁሉ ዘንድ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ከቶ ያልተደረገውን ተአምራት በህዝብህ ሁሉ ፊት አደርጋለሁ፤ እኔም በአንተ ዘንድ የምሰራው ነገር የሚያስፈራ ነውና አንተ ያለህበት ይህ ህዝብ ሁሉ የእግዚአብሄርን ስራ ያያል።
English: and he said behold i make a covenant: before all thy people i will do marvels such as have not been done in all the earth nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the lord: for it is a terrible thing that i will do with thee.

Amharic: የጉባኤ አባል የሆኑ አንዳንድ ግለሰቦች በሽማግሌዎች ላይ ጉድለት እንዳዩ ስለተሰማቸው ብቻ ከባድ ሃጢአት ከፈፀሙ በኋላ እርዳታ እንዲሰጧቸው በተመደቡ ሽማግሌዎች ፊት ለመቅረብ ፈቃደኛ ሳይሆኑ ቀርተዋል።
English: because of what they perceive as defects in the elders some individuals who engage in serious wrongdoing in the congregation have refused to appear before a committee of elders assigned to help them.

Amharic: ተነሱና ከዚህ ሂዱ ; ይህ የማረፊያ ቦታ አይደለምና።
English: get up and go for this is no place of rest.

Amharic: እርሱም ያ በሌሊት የሚያስተኛችሁ በቀንም የሰራችሁትን ሁሉ የሚያውቅ ከዚያም የተወሰነው ጊዜ ይፈፀም ዘንድ በእርሱ ውስጥ የሚቀሰቅሳችሁ ነው፡፡ ከዚያም መመለሻችሁ ወደ እርሱ ነው፡፡ ከዚያም ትሰሩት የነበራችሁትን ሁሉ ይነግራችኋል፡፡።
English: and it is he who takes your souls by night and knows what you have committed by day. then he revives you therein i.e. by day that a specified term may be fulfilled. then to him will be your return; then he will inform you about what you used to do.

Amharic: ሰልሞን ከረኣብ ቦኤዝን ወለደ፤ቦኤዝ ከሩት ኢዮቤድን ወለደ፤ኢዮቤድ እሴይን ወለደ፤።
English: salʹmon became father to boʹaz by raʹhab;boʹaz became father to oʹbed by ruth;oʹbed became father to jesʹse.

Amharic: ምስሎቹን ሳፈራርሳቸው ምንም የማይረቡ ነገሮች እንደሆኑ ተገነዘብኩ።
English: i pulled the icons apart and saw that they were nothing more than colorful tinfoil.

Amharic: ወይም ደግሞ የተባለውን ድረ ገፃችንን መጎብኘት ትችላለህ።
English: or you can visit our website jw.org.

Amharic: ሲሞን በገንዘብ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ለማግኘት ሞከረ።
English: simon tries to buy holy spirit.

Amharic: አምላክን እንደሚያውቁ በይፋ ይናገራሉ ; ሆኖም በስራቸው ይክዱታል ; ምክንያቱም አስፀያፊና የማይታዘዙ እንዲሁም ለማንኛውም አይነት መልካም ስራ የማይበቁ ናቸው።
English: they publicly declare that they know god but they disown him by their works because they are detestable and disobedient and not approved for good work of any sort.

Amharic: ማንኛውም ባለፈቃድ በዚህ አዋጅ አንቀፅ 33 ንኡስ አንቀፅ 11 ስር የተደነገገውን የተላለፈ ከብር 80 000 - ብር 100 000 በሚደርስ የገንዘብ መቀጫ ይቀጣል፤።
English: a holder of a license or a certificate of competence who breaches the provision set under sub article 11 of article 33 of this proclamation shall be punishable with a fine of 80 000 - 100 000 birr.

Amharic: የቤቱ ጌታ አድርጎ ሾመው።
English: he made him master of his household.

Amharic: ለአምላክህ ለእግዚአብሄር ስእለት በተሳልህ ጊዜ አምላክህ እግዚአብሄር ከአንተ ፈፅሞ ይሻዋልና፥ ሃጢአትም ይሆንብሃልና መክፈሉን አታዘገይ።
English: when thou shalt vow a vow unto the lord thy god thou shalt not slack to pay it: for the lord thy god will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.

Amharic: በግልፅ ለማየት እንደሚቻለው ያህዌና የጉባኤው ራስ የሆነው ኢየሱስ በዚያ ወሳኝ ወቅት ወንድም ራስልን ተጠቅመውበታል።
English: clearly at that pivotal time brother russell was used by jehovah and the head of the congregation.

Amharic: እሱም ‘አንተ አባቴ ነህ፤አምላኬና አዳኝ ኣለቴ ነህ’ ብሎ ይጠራኛል።
English: he will call out to me: ‘you are my father my god and the rock of my salvation.’.

Amharic: ሆኖም ወንድሞቹ ወደ በኣሉ ከሄዱ በኋላ እሱም በግልፅ ሳይሆን በስውር ወደዚያው ሄደ።
English: but when his brothers had gone up to the festival then he also went up not openly but in secret.

Amharic: ፌዘኛ ጥበብን ይፈልጋል ; ሆኖም አያገኛትም።
English: the scoffer seeks wisdom and finds none.

Amharic: በተጨማሪም የሚቃጠሉት መባዎችና የህብረት መስዋእቶቹ ስብ እንዲሁም ከሚቃጠሉት መባዎች ጋር የሚቀርቡት የመጠጥ መባዎች ብዙ ነበሩ። በዚህ መንገድ የይሆዋ ቤት አገልግሎት እንደገና ተደራጀ።
English: also there were many burnt offerings as well as the fat pieces of the communion sacrifices and the drink offerings for the burnt offerings. thus the service of the house of jehovah was restored.

Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ ጥበበኛ ወላጆች ለልጆቻቸው ምክንያታዊ የሆኑ መመሪያዎችን በመስጠት ልጆቹ እነዚህን መመሪያዎች እንዲታዘዙ ያሰለጥኗቸዋል።
English: however wise parents set reasonable rules and train their children to abide by them.

Amharic: ለሚገደሉበትም ቀን ለይተህ አቆያቸው።
English: and set them apart for the day of killing.

Amharic: እሷም ቀዩን ገመድ መስኮቱ ላይ አሰረችው።
English: afterward she tied the scarlet cord in the window.

Amharic: ኡዚ ዘራህያህን ወለደ ; ዘራህያህ መራዮትን ወለደ።
English: uzzi became father to zerahiah ; zerahiah became father to meraioth.

Amharic: ዳዊት ይህን ሲያብራራ ታሞ በአልጋ ላይ ተኝቶ ሳለ ይሆዋ ይደግፈዋል፤ በታመመበት ወቅት መኝታውን ሙሉ በሙሉ ትቀይርለታለህ ብሏል።
English: david explained: jehovah will sustain him on his sickbed; during his sickness you will completely change his bed.

Amharic: አንድ ሰው ከሞተ በኋላ በውስጡ ያለች አንዲት ረቂቅ ነገር በሌላ አለም በህይወት መኖሯን የምትቀጥል ከሆነ አምላክ እንደተናገረው ሞት ለሃጢአት ቅጣት አይሆንም ነበር።
English: because if a part of us moves on to live in some other realm after we die then death would not be the penalty for sin as god stated.

Amharic: ወዳጅ ሆይ፥ ነፍስህ እንደሚከናወን፥ በነገር ሁሉ እንዲከናወንልህና ጤና እንዲኖርህ እፀልያለሁ።
English: beloved i wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prospereth.

Amharic: ያህዌ መልአኩን በመላክ በአንድ ሌሊት 185 000 የሚያክሉትን የሰናክሬም ወታደሮች ገደለ።
English: jehovah sent an angel to destroy 185 000 of sennacheribs soldiers in one night.

Amharic: ሃዋርያ የካናዱውን ክፍል የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ሂደትና አፈፃፀም በቅርበት እንደተከታተለው የአካባ ቢው ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ አስተባባሪ ኮሚቴ ለብዙ ቀናቶ ች ባደረገው ያላሰለሰ ከፍተኛ ጥረት በእለቱ ኦታዋ ላይ በተካሄደው ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ ላይ ከተለያዩ ከተሞች የመጡ ኢትዮጵያውያን ተካፋይ ሆነዋል።
English: according to hawarya who closely followed the canadian side of the process and execution of opposition process in the great effort the coordinating committee made on the date in ottawa many ethiopians who came from various places participated in the demonstration.

Amharic: ክቡር አቶ ከበደ ሚካኤል።
English: h.e ato kebede mikael.

Amharic: በትናንሽ ነገሮችም እንኳ እምነት የሚጣልብህ መሆንህን ካስመሰከርክ በወላጆችህ ዘንድ የበለጠ አመኔታ ታተርፋለህ።
English: if you prove trustworthy even in small things your parents are likely to trust you more in the future.

Amharic: የሀጅ ስራዎቻችሁንም በፈፀማችሁ ጊዜ አባቶቻችሁን እንደምታወሱ ወይም ይበልጥ የበረታን ማውሳት አላህን አውሱ፡፡ ከሰዎችም ውስጥ፡- «ጌታችን ሆይ! በምድረኣለም መልካም እድልን ስጠን» የሚል ሰው አለ፡፡ ለርሱም በመጨረሻይቱ አገር ከእድል ምንም የለውም፡፡።
English: and when you have completed your rites remember allāh like your previous remembrance of your fathers or with much greater remembrance. and among the people is he who says our lord give us in this world and he will have in the hereafter no share.

Amharic: ከዚያም እንዲህ በል፦ ‘ባቢሎን በእሷ ላይ ከማመጣው ጥፋት የተነሳ እንዲህ ትሰምጣለች፤ ዳግመኛም አትነሳም፤ እነሱም ይዝላሉ።’” የኤርምያስ ቃል እዚህ ላይ ያበቃል።
English: then say ‘this is how babylon will sink down and never rise again because of the calamity that i am bringing on her; and they will grow weary.’” down to this point are the words of jeremiah.

Amharic: “ከህዝቤ መካከል አብሮህ ላለ ችግረኛ ገንዘብ ብታበድር እንደ አራጣ አበዳሪ አትሁንበት። ወለድም አትጠይቁት።
English: “if you lend money to anyone poor of my people someone who is dwelling with you you must not become like a moneylender to him. you must not charge him interest.

Amharic: «ጌታችን በመካከላችን ይሰበስባል፡፡ ከዚያም በመካከላችን በእውነት ይፈርዳል፡፡ እርሱም በትክክል ፈራጁ አዋቂው ነው» በላቸው፡፡።
English: say our lord will bring us together; then he will judge between us in truth. and he is the knowing judge.

Amharic: ከሌዋውያን 4 600 ነበሩ።
English: of the levites 4 600.

Amharic: እናም ከፍላጎት የተነሳ ዩ.ኤስ ስህተት ልትሰራ ትችላለች ; ሰውየውን ከስልጣን ለማውረድ አሁንም ተስፋ አላት ; ግን በእሱ በኩል የሚፈፀም አንድ ስህተት ለሞት ይዳርገዋል።
English: and out of necessity : the u.s. can make mistakes and still hope to remove him from power but a single error on his part could cost him his life.

Amharic: የመበለቲቱን ወሰን ግን ያስከብራል።
English: but he will preserve the boundary of the widow.

Amharic: ለምሳሌ በሮም ለነበሩ ክርስቲያኖች እንግዲህ ወንድሞች ስለ እኔ ወደ አምላክ በመፀለይ ከእኔ ጋር አብራችሁ እንድትጋደሉ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስና ከመንፈስ በሚገኘው ፍቅር እማፀናችኋለሁ በማለት ፅፏል።
English: for example to the christians in rome he wrote : now i exhort you brothers through our lord jesus christ and through the love of the spirit that you exert yourselves with me in prayers to god for me.

Amharic: 15 ጦርነት : በአንደኛውና በሁለተኛው የአለም ጦርነት ከ 60 ሚሊዮን የሚበልጡ ሰዎች ህይወት እንደጠፋ ይገመታል።
English: 15 wars : the two world wars took an estimated 60 million or more lives.

Amharic: ማናችንም ብንሆን በዚህች ምድር ላይ እንዲህ አይነት ነገር ሲከናወን አይተን ባናውቅም ይህ ከማይታዩት እጅግ ታላላቅ ነገሮች መካከል አንዱ እንደሚሆን ምንም ጥርጥር የለውም።
English: none of us have ever seen such a thing take place ; it will surely be one of the grandest of the things unseen.

Amharic: እነሱም ልክ በሰፈሩበት ሁኔታ እያንዳንዳቸው ቦታቸውን ጠብቀው ሶስት ነገድ ባቀፈው ምድባቸው መሰረት መጓዝ ይኖርባቸዋል።
English: they should travel in the same order as they encamp with each in his place according to their three tribe divisions.

Amharic: የአሜሪካ ዜጐች ውጥረት ካለባቸው የኢትዮጵያና የኤርትራ ድንበሮች አካባቢ እንዲርቁ የአሜሪካ ውጭ ጉዳይ መስሪያ ቤት ጠየቀ።
English: the american foreign affairs office requested american citizens to be far away from the tensioned areas of ethiopia and eritrea.

Amharic: ከዚያም «ይህ ያ በእርሱ ታስተባብሉበት የነበራችሁት ነው» ይባላሉ፡፡።
English: then it will be said to them this is what you used to deny.

Amharic: በዚህ ጊዜ ኢየሱስ እንዲህ አለው : ሰይፍህን ወደ ሰገባው መልስ ; ሰይፍ የሚመዙ ሁሉ በሰይፍ ይጠፋሉ።
English: then jesus said to him : return your sword to its place for all those who take up the sword will perish by the sword.

Amharic: በውጊያው ቀን ቀረርቶ ይሰማል።
English: with a war cry in the day of battle.

Amharic: 5. ጳውሎስ በሮም ላይ የትኛውን አስፈላጊ ጉዳይ አንስቷል።
English: 5. at romans what serious matter did paul address.

Amharic: አመዱን ማስወገጃ ባልዲዎችን፣ አካፋዎችን፣ ሳህኖችን፣ ሹካዎችንና መኮስተሪያዎችን ትሰራለህ፤ እቃዎቹንም ሁሉ ከመዳብ ትሰራቸዋለህ።
English: you will make buckets for clearing away its ashes along with shovels bowls forks and fire holders and you will make all its utensils of copper.

Amharic: አገረ ገዢውም እንዲናገር በጭንቅላቱ ምልክት በሰጠው ጊዜ ጳውሎስ እንዲህ ሲል መለሰ፦ “ለብዙ ኣመታት ለዚህ ህዝብ ፈራጅ ሆነህ ስታገለግል መቆየትህን አውቃለሁ፤ በመሆኑም ስለ ራሴ የመከላከያ መልስ የማቀርበው በደስታ ነው።
English: when the governor nodded to paul to speak he answered: “knowing well that this nation has had you as judge for many years i readily speak in my own defense.

Amharic: አንዳንዶች እስክንድርን ከህዝቡ መካከል ባወጡት ጊዜ አይሁዳውያን ወደ ፊት ገፉት ; እስክንድርም የመከላከያ ሃሳቡን ለህዝቡ ሊያቀርብ ፈልጎ በእጁ ምልክት ሰጣቸው።
English: so they brought alexander out of the crowd the jews shoving him forward and alexander motioned with his hand and wanted to make his defense to the people.

Amharic: ወደ እነዚያ እነርሱ ብዙ ሺህ ሆነው ሞትን ለመፍራት ከሀገሮቻቸው ወደ ወጡት ሰዎች እውቀትህ አልደረሰምን? አላህም ለነርሱ «ሙቱ» አላቸው፤ ፡፡ ከዚያም ህያው አደረጋቸው፡፡ አላህም በሰዎች ላይ ባለችሮታ ነው፤ ግን አብዛኛዎቹ ሰዎች አያመሰግኑም፡፡።
English: have you not considered those who left their homes in many thousands fearing death? allāh said to them die; then he restored them to life. and allāh is the possessor of bounty for the people but most of the people do not show gratitude.

Amharic: ከዚያም ሴቶች ልጆቻችንን እንድርላችኋለን፤ እኛም ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን እናገባለን፤ አብረናችሁም እንኖራለን፤ አንድ ህዝብም እንሆናለን።
English: then we will give our daughters to you and we will take your daughters for ourselves and we will dwell with you and become one people.

Amharic: ሁሉም በያህዌ ላይ ፅኑ እምነት እንደነበራቸው እንድንገነዘብ ያስችሉናል።
English: each reveals unwavering trust in jehovah.

Amharic: እነሱም ይህን ሲሰሙ እጅግ ተቆጡ፤ ሊገድሏቸውም ፈለጉ።
English: when they heard this they were infuriated and wanted to do away with them.

Amharic: ንፁሃን ሰዎችን ያለምክንያት ለማጥቃት እናደፍጣለን።
English: we will lie hidden waiting for innocent victims without cause.

Amharic: ዮሃንስ እንደነዚህ ስላሉት ሃይማኖታዊ አታላዮች ከመፃፉ ከረጅም ጊዜ በፊት ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ተከታዮቹን እንዲህ በማለት መክሯቸዋል : በውስጣቸው ነጣቂ ተኩላዎች ሆነው ሳሉ የበግ ለምድ ለብሰው ወደ እናንተ ከሚመጡ ሃሰተኛ ነቢያት ተጠንቀቁ።
English: long before john wrote about such religious deceivers jesus christ advised his followers : be on the watch for the false prophets who come to you in sheeps covering but inside they are ravenous wolves.

Amharic: የመፅሃፍ ቅዱስ ተማሪዎቹ የኢየሱስን ደም ለመወከል ተገቢ የሚሆነው ምንም ያልተቀላቀለበት ቀይ የወይን ጠጅ እንደሆነ ከጊዜ በኋላ ተገንዝበዋል።

English: and saul was consenting unto his death. and at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of judæa and samaria except the apostles.

Amharic: በመቀጠልም የእህል መባውን አቀረበ፤ ከላዩ ላይም እፍኝ ሙሉ አንስቶ ጠዋት ላይ ከሚቀርበው የሚቃጠል መባ በተጨማሪ በመሰዊያው ላይ እንዲጨስ አደረገ።
English: he next presented the grain offering filling his hand with some of it and making it smoke on the altar in addition to the burnt offering of the morning.

Amharic: እነዚህን እህቶች በጣም እንወዳቸዋለን ! አንዳንዶቹ በአምላክ አገልግሎት የቀድሞውን ያህል ብዙ ማከናወን አይችሉ ይሆናል ; ይሁንና አሁንም ቢሆን ደፋሮች በመሆን የሚሰሩት ስራ አለ።
English: how we love these dear sisters ! some may not be able to do as much as they once did in gods service but they can still show courage and go to work.

Amharic: ለሚወዱኝ ውድ የሆኑ ነገሮችን አወርሳለሁ፤ግምጃ ቤቶቻቸውንም እሞላለሁ።
English: i give a rich inheritance to those who love me and i fill up their storehouses.

Amharic: ሙሴም ልክ ይሆዋ ባዘዘው መሰረት ከበሬው የቀረውን፣ ቆዳውን፣ ስጋውንና ፈርሱን ከሰፈሩ ውጭ በእሳት አቃጠለው።
English: then he had the rest of the bull its skin its flesh and its dung burned with fire outside the camp just as jehovah had commanded moses.

Amharic: ያም ሆኖ በሰው ፍርሃት አልተሸነፈም።
English: but he was not trembling at men.

Amharic: ሃዋርያው ዮሃንስ ደግሞ እንዲህ ብሏል : ለኑሮ የሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳዊ ነገሮች ያሉት ሰው ወንድሙ ሲቸገር ተመልክቶ ሳይራራለት ቢቀር የአምላክ ፍቅር በእሱ ውስጥ እንዴት ሊኖር ይችላል ? እያንዳንዱ ክርስቲያን የተቸገሩትን በመርዳት ረገድ እንዲህ ያለ ሃላፊነት ካለበት ጉባኤዎችስ እንዲህ ማድረግ የለባቸውም።
English: the apostle john too reasoned : whoever has the material possessions of this world and sees his brother in need and yet refuses to show him compassion in what way does the love of god remain in him ? if individual christians have such obligations toward the needy is that not also true of the congregations.

Amharic: ኩባን እንደ ምሳሌ እንውሰድ።
English: take cuba for example.

Amharic: ካመናችሁ በኋላ በእሱ አማካኝነት ቃል በተገባው መንፈስ ቅዱስ ታትማችኋል ; ይህም ለአምላክ ታላቅ ምስጋና ያስገኝ ዘንድ የራሱ ንብረት የሆኑትን በቤዛ አማካኝነት ነፃ ለማውጣት ለውርሻችን አስቀድሞ የተሰጠ ማረጋገጫ ነው።
English: after you believed you were sealed by means of him with the promised holy spirit which is a token in advance of our inheritance for the purpose of releasing gods own possession by a ransom to his glorious praise.

Amharic: ህዝብ የሚጠይቀው አጭር ጥያቄ ለምን ? የሚል ሆኖአል።
English: the short question people ask why ? this is it.

Amharic: የሚያሳውቃችሁ የእኔ ከሆነው ወስዶ ስለሆነ እሱ እኔን ያከብረኛል።
English: that one will glorify me because he will receive from what is mine and will declare it to you.

Amharic: 15 የእስራኤል ብሄር ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ሳይቀበል በመቅረቱ በመጨረሻ በአምላክ ፊት የነበረውን ልዩ ቦታና የመንግስት ካህናት የመሆን ተስፋ አጣ።
English: 15 because of rejecting jesus christ the nation of israel finally lost their favored status with god along with the prospect of ever becoming a kingdom of priests.

Amharic: ወንድማችሁ ስለሆነ ብቻ ከባሪያይቱ የወለደውን ልጁን አቢሜሌክን በሴኬም መሪዎች ላይ አነገሳችሁት።
English: then you made abimelech the son of his slave girl king over the leaders of shechem just because he is your brother.

Amharic: የእስራኤል የበኩር ልጅ የሆነው የሮቤል ወንዶች ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።
English: these are the sons of reuben israels firstborn.

Amharic: ከአዳዲሶቹ ትርጉሞች አንዳንዶቹ መለኮታዊውን ስም ሙሉ በሙሉ ከትርጉማቸው ውስጥ ያወጡት ሲሆን ሌሎች ደግሞ በጥቂት ቦታዎች ላይ ብቻ አስገብተውታል።
English: some of the newer translations have removed it entirely while others retain it in just a few locations.

Amharic: ያህዌ የፅዮንን ሴት ልጅ ቅጥር ለማፍረስ ቆርጧል።
English: jehovah has resolved to destroy the wall of the daughter of zion.

Amharic: አንደኛው ምሳሌ ታላንት ስለተሰጣቸው ባሪያዎች የሚገልፅ ሲሆን ሌላው ደግሞ በጎች ከፍየሎች እንደሚለዩት ሁሉ ሰዎችም ስለ መለየታቸው ይናገራል።
English: one involves slaves who are given talents and the other speaks of people being separated as sheep are from goats.

Amharic: ቃል መግባታችሁ ለችግሩ መፍትሄ እንጂ መንስኤ አይደለም።
English: commitment is the solution not the problem.

Amharic: ትንሽ ነገር በማስታወሻ መያዝ እንኳ ፍላጎት ያሳየውን ሰውና የሚኖርበትን ቦታ ለማስታወስ እንዴት እንደሚረዳ አሳየኋቸው ; በተጨማሪም ማስታወሻ መያዝ ተመላልሶ መጠየቅ ለማድረግ ያነሳሳል።
English: i showed them how even a simple note reminds us of the interested person and where he lives ; it also serves as an incentive for us to make the return visit.

Amharic: የሲሳራ እናት በፍርግርጉ አጮልቃ ወደ ውጭ ተመለከተች።
English: siseras mother peered out from the lattice.

Amharic: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ አብረውኝ ለሚሰሩት ለጵርስቅላና ለአቂላ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ፤።
English: give my greetings to prisʹca and aqʹui·la my fellow workers in christ jesus.

Amharic: ባለፀጋውም በሃብቱ አይኩራራ።
English: and let not the rich man boast about his riches.

Amharic: ሰልፉ አመፅ አልባና አነስተኛ ወንጀል ያስከተለ ነበር ; ግን በዚያ ሰውዬ ላይ ያስከተለው ነገር አመፅ ያስከተለና የመጨረሻ ነበር።
English: the demonstration was non violent and involved only a simple misdemeanor but its impact on that individual was violent and terminal.

Amharic: ከዚያም ኢያሱና ከእሱ ጋር የነበሩት እስራኤላውያን በሙሉ ከኤግሎን ወደ ኬብሮን በመውጣት ኬብሮንን ወጓት።
English: then joshua together with all israel went up from egʹlon to hebʹron and fought against it.

Amharic: እሱም ሊቀ ካህናቱን ኢያሱን በያህዌ መልአክ ፊት ቆሞ አሳየኝ ; ሰይጣንም እሱን ለመቃወም በስተ ቀኙ ቆሞ ነበር።
English: and he showed me joshua the high priest standing before the angel of jehovah and satan was standing at his right hand to resist him.

Amharic: ከዚያም ተነስታ አገልጋዮቿን በማስከተል ወደ አገሯ ተመለሰች።
English: then she left and returned to her own land together with her servants.

Amharic: ደግሞም የሚነባበረውን ዳቦ፣ ለእህል መባ የሚያገለግለውን የላመ ዱቄት፣ እርሾ ያልገባበትን ስስ ቂጣ፣ በምጣድ የሚጋገረውን ቂጣና በዘይት የሚለወሰውን ሊጥ በማዘጋጀት እንዲሁም ከሁሉም ኣይነት መለኪያዎችና መስፈሪያዎች ጋር የተያያዙ ስራዎችን በማከናወን ያግዟቸው ነበር።
English: they assisted with the layer bread the fine flour for the grain offering the wafers of unleavened bread the griddle cakes the mixed dough and all measures of quantity and size.

Amharic: ግፍ ተፈፀመበት፤ መከራም ለመቀበል ፈቃደኛ ሆነ፤ነገር ግን አፉን አልከፈተም። እንደ በግ ለመታረድ ተነዳ፤በሸላቾቿ ፊት ዝም እንደምትል በግ፣እሱም አፉን አልከፈተም።
English: he was oppressed and he let himself be afflicted but he would not open his mouth. he was brought like a sheep to the slaughter like a ewe that is silent before its shearers and he would not open his mouth.

Amharic: መጥፎ ነገር ለሚሸርቡና።
English: woe to those who scheme what is harmful.

Amharic: እርግጥ ነው በወቅቱ የነበሩት ሰዎች አካላዊ ሁኔታ አዳምና ሄዋን በአንድ ወቅት ለነበራቸው ፍፅምና በጣም ቅርብ ነበር።
English: granted humans were much closer to the physical perfection that adam and eve had once possessed and lost.

Amharic: በመካከላቸውም እኖር ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋቸው አምላካቸው እግዚአብሄር እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ ያውቃሉ፤ እኔ አምላካቸው እግዚአብሄር ነኝ።
English: and they shall know that i am the lord their god that brought them forth out of the land of egypt that i may dwell among them: i am the lord their god.

Amharic: በዚህ ጊዜ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይፈራሉ።
English: then all men will become afraid.

Amharic: በደረሰብኝ ጉስቁልና በጠፋሁ ነበር።
English: i would have perished in my affliction.

Amharic: የእግዚአብሄርንም ታቦት የተሸከሙ ስድስት እርምጃ በሄዱ ጊዜ አንድ በሬና አንድ ፍሪዳ ሰዋ።
English: and it was so that when they that bare the ark of the lord had gone six paces he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

Amharic: መፅሃፍ ቅዱስ ሁሉም የሰው ልጆች ያልተጠበቁ ክስተቶች ያጋጥሟቸዋል በማለት እውነታውን ይናገራል።
English: the bible states a fundamental truth about humans : unexpected events overtake them all.

Amharic: ጥላቻው በተንኮል ቢሸፈንም።
English: though his hatred is concealed by deceit.

Amharic: ኣለሙም ምኞቱም ያልፋሉ፤ የእግዚአብሄርን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
English: love not the world neither the things that are in the world. if any man love the world the love of the father is not in him.

Amharic: በተመሳሳይም በአዲስ አበባ ከተማ በጥቂት ተማሪዎችና ዱርዬዎች ከትናትን በስቲያ ተከስቶ የነበረው ሁከትና ዝርፊያ በትናንቱ እለት ሙሉ በሙሉ ተወግዶ ህዝቡ ሰላማዊ የእለት ተእለት ኑሮውን እያካሄደ ሲሆን ከተማዋም በፍፁም መረጋጋት ላይ ትገኛለች።
English: similarly the disturbance and plundering that occurred the day before yesterday in addis ababa by few students and hooligans was completely controlled yesterday and the people are leading their daily lives the city is also in perfect stability.

Amharic: ኢየሱስ ወደ ባህሩ ዳርቻ ሲመጣ እጅግ ብዙ ህዝብ ተመለከተና በጣም አዘነላቸው ; በመካከላቸው የነበሩትንም ህመምተኞች ፈወሰ።

Amharic: ሁለተኛ ኤልሳእ የለመነውን ነገር እንዲያገኝ ከፈለገ የመጣው ቢመጣ ከኤልያስ ጋር ለመቆየት ባደረገው ቁርጥ ውሳኔ መፅናት ነበረበት።

English: so the israelites lived among the canaanites the hittites the amorites the perizzites the hivites and the jebusites.

Amharic: እያንዳንዱ የብር ሳህን 130 ሰቅል፣ እያንዳንዱም ጎድጓዳ ሳህን 70 ሰቅል ይመዝን ነበር፤ እቃዎቹ የተሰሩበት ብር በአጠቃላይ፣ እንደ ቋሚ መለኪያ ሆኖ በሚያገለግለው በቅዱሱ ስፍራ ሰቅል መሰረት 2 400 ሰቅል ነበር፤።

Amharic: በኢራቅ ብሄራዊ ደሃንነት ላይ ከባድ ስጋት የሚያስከትል ነገር መከሰቱን ጊዜያዊ መንግስት እስካመነበት ድረስ ከ 60 ቀናት ላልበለጠ ጊዜ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ሊታወጅ ይችላል በማለት ባለፈው ኦገስት ባወጣው የብሄራዊ ደሃንነት ህግ መሰረት ጊዜያዊው መንግስት የኩርዶችን ክልል በመተው በኢራቅ ውስጥ ለ 60 ቀናት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ አውጇል።

Amharic: የእሳቸው ገንዘቡን ያለመክፈል መዘዙ ለሌች ንፁሀን አባቶች መትረፉንም ታዛቢዎች ይናገራሉ።
English: his not paying the money brought about many disputes among many innocent fathers observers told.

Amharic: አንድ ቀን ኤሳው ውጭ ውሎ በጣም ደክሞት ሲመጣ ያእቆብ ወጥ እየሰራ ነበር።
English: on one occasion jacob was boiling some stew when esau returned from the field exhausted.

Amharic: በዚያ የህግ ሰጪው ድርሻ ተለይቶ ተቀምጧልና።
English: for there the allotment of a lawgiver is reserved.

Amharic: አዋላጆች ግን እግዚአብሄርን ፈሩ፥ የግብፅ ንጉስም እንዳዘዛቸው አላደረጉም፥ ወንዶቹን ህፃናትንም አዳኑአቸው።
English: but the midwives feared god and did not as the king of egypt commanded them but saved the men children alive.

Amharic: ሆኖም ፋታ ሲያገኙ እንደገና በፊትህ መጥፎ ነገር አደረጉ ; አንተም በሚጨቁኗቸው ጠላቶቻቸው እጅ ጣልካቸው።
English: but as soon as they had relief they would again do what is bad before you and you would abandon them to the hand of their enemies who would dominate them.

Amharic: አምላክ አገልጋዮቹን በሚገባ ያውቃል።
English: god knows his servants well.

Amharic: ንጉስ ለድሆች በትክክል ሲፈርድ።
English: when a king judges the poor fairly.

Amharic: አህያይቱንና ውርንጭላዋን አምጥተው መደረቢያዎቻቸውን በላያቸው ላይ አደረጉ፤ እሱም ተቀመጠባቸው።
English: they brought the donkey and its colt and they put their outer garments on them and he sat on them.

Amharic: “ሆኖም የሚኩራራ በይሆዋ ይኩራራ።”።
English: “but the one who boasts let him boast in jehovah.”.

Amharic: በመሆኑም ቅዱስ ዘር የሆኑት እነዚህ ሰዎች በምድሪቱ ከሚኖሩት ህዝቦች ጋር ተቀላቅለዋል።
English: now they the holy offspring have become mingled with the peoples of the lands.

English: the money was donated by a benevolent christian who is the owner of axum hotel the report detailed and after having announced through the microphone for the christian laity aba gebretsadik forbade that the money should not go to the accounts ledger through official receipt despite the oppositions mounting form various similar officials of the church asking the entry of the money through official means.

English: this is what the sovereign lord jehovah says: “woe to the stupid prophets who follow their own spirit when they have seen nothing.

Amharic: በረከት እንደ ዝናብ ይወርዳል።
English: blessings will pour down like the rains.

Amharic: ኤልሳእም ከእኛ ጋር ያሉት ከእነርሱ ጋር ካሉት ይበልጣሉና አትፍራ አለው።
English: do not be afraid said elisha for there are more who are with us than those who are with them.

Amharic: ሄደውም የማያውቋቸውንና ያልታዘዙትን ሌሎችን አማልክት ስላመለኩና ስለ ሰገዱላቸው፥።
English: for they went and served other gods and worshipped them gods whom they knew not and whom he had not given unto them.

Amharic: ማንኛውም ሰው ለዚህ አዋጅ አፈፃፀም የመተባበር ግዴታ አለበት፡፡።
English: any person shall have duty to cooperate for the proper implementation of this proclamation.

Amharic: ታዲያ በዛሬው ጊዜ የሚታየው ምንድን ነው።
English: what do we see today.

Amharic: እኔ የኢየሱስን ማህተም በስጋዬ ተሸክሜአለሁና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አንድ ስንኳ አያድክመኝ።
English: from henceforth let no man trouble me for i bear in my body the marks of the lord jesus.

Amharic: 13 14. ለሌሎች ሲሉ ብዙ መስዋእትነት ስለከፈሉ ሰዎች የሚገልፁ የመፅሃፍ ቅዱስ ዘገባዎችን ስታነብ ምን ይሰማሃል።
English: 13 14. what do you think of the bible examples of those who made great sacrifices in behalf of others.

Amharic: እንደ ባስልኤልና ኤልያብ ሁሉ እኛም እርካታ የምናገኘው የያህዌን ፈቃድ በመፈፀማችንና የእሱን ሞገስ በማግኘታችን ነው።

English: 10. when we put the kingdom first and experience gods support how is our trust in jehovah affected.

English: satan challenged the legitimacy of jehovahs rulership when he rebelled against him.

Amharic: ሰውንም ሁሉ በራሪውን በአንገቱ አስያዝነው፡፡ ለእርሱም በትንሳኤ ቀን የተዘረጋ ሆኖ የሚያገኘው የሆነን መፅሀፍ እናወጣለታለን፡፡።
English: and for every person we have imposed his fate upon his neck and we will produce for him on the day of resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.

English: and when they are taking you to hand you over do not be anxious beforehand about what to say; but whatever is given you in that hour say this for you are not the ones speaking but the holy spirit is.

Amharic: እኔ አምላክህ ነኝና አትጨነቅ።
English: do not be anxious for i am your god.

Amharic: አምላክ የበቀል እርምጃ እንዲወስድ የቀረበ ፀሎት።
English: a prayer for vengeance by god.

Amharic: አለቆች የመሰሉት ግን፥ በፊት ማን እንደ ነበሩ አይገደኝም፤ እግዚአብሄር የሰውን ፊት አይቶ አያደላም፤ አለቆች የመሰሉት አንዳች እንኳ አልጨመሩልኝምና፥።
English: but of these who seemed to be somewhat for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me.

Amharic: ደግሞም ቀስ በቀስ እየተረጋጋሁ መጣሁ።
English: and i gradually felt calmer.

Amharic: ትተኛለህ ; እንቅልፍህም ጣፋጭ ይሆናል።
English: you will lie down and your sleep will be pleasant.

English: after becoming father to me·thuʹse·lah eʹnoch continued to walk with the true god for 300 years. and he became father to sons and daughters.

English: but the wicked will perish.

English: he stretched out his hand touched the leper and with a voice reflecting both strength and tenderness jesus said : i want to ! be made clean.

English: to grow food from the land.

English: yea they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils.

English: if we tell others how much we have benefited from our personal study of the bible we may encourage them to obtain such benefits by being diligent students of the scriptures.

English: said it was to be recalled.

English: a prophet like moses.

Amharic: አቤቱ፥ ፈትነሀናልና፥ ብርንም እንደሚያነጥሩት አንጥረሀናልና።
English: for thou o god hast proved us: thou hast tried us as silver is tried.

Amharic: ወደዚህ ህዝብ ሂድና። መስማትን ትሰማላችሁና አታስተውሉም፥ ማየትንም ታያላችሁና አትመለከቱም፤።
English: saying go unto this people and say hearing ye shall hear and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see and not perceive.

Amharic: 10 ያህዌ ጳውሎስን ሊታደገው ይችላል።
English: 10 yes jehovah could rescue paul.

Amharic: ዲያብሎስ የመጣው ከየት ነው።
English: god did not create the devil.

Amharic: አምላክ በህዝቡ ላይ ይፈርዳል።
English: god judges between the loyal and the wicked.

Amharic: በኤጀንሲ አማካይነት ወደ ውጭ አገር ለስራ ተቀጥረው ለሚሄዱ ሰራተኞች ስለአጠቃላይ የስራ ሁኔታና ስለሚሄዱ ባቸው አገሮች ሁኔታ መግለጫ እና የቅድመ-ቅጥርና ቅድመ-ጉዞ ትምህርትና ምክር አገልግሎት የተሰጠ መሆኑን የማረጋገጥ፤።
English: ensure that the agency has given orientation on general conditions of work situation of receiving countries and pre-employment and pre-departure orientation and counseling services to workers destined for overseas employment.

Amharic: አቤቱ፥ ተመለስ ነፍሴንም አድናት፥ ስለ ቸርነትህም አድነኝ።
English: return o lord deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies sake.

Amharic: እሱም ሆነ የመጀመሪያዎቹ ባልና ሚስት በያህዌ ላይ ማመፃቸው ትእቢተኞች እንደሆኑ ያሳያል።
English: in rebelling against jehovahs sovereignty he and the first human couple acted arrogantly.

Amharic: ተራሮች ወደ ላይ ወጡ፤ ሸለቆዎችም ወደ ታች ወረዱ፤ሁሉም ወዳዘጋጀህላቸው ቦታ ሄዱ።
English: -mountains ascended and valleys descended-to the place you established for them.

Amharic: ወንድምህ ንዴቱ እስኪበርድለትና ያደረግክበትን እስኪረሳ ድረስ እዚያ ቆይ። እኔም እልክብህና አስጠራሃለሁ። ሁለታችሁንም በአንድ ቀን ለምን ልጣ?”።
English: until your brother’s anger toward you subsides and he forgets what you have done to him. then i will send for you from there. why should i lose both of you in one day?”.

Amharic: የሰማይ ወፎች ሁሉ በቅርንጫፎቹ ላይ ጎጇቸውን ሰሩ።
English: all the birds of the sky nested in its boughs.

Amharic: 4. የአምላክ ስም እንዲቀደስ ማድረግ የምንችለው እንዴት ነው።
English: 4. in what ways do we sanctify gods name.

Amharic: ስለ ህዝቡም ሃጢአት የሚሰዋውን መስዋእት ፍየል ያርዳል፥ ደሙም ወደ መጋረጃው ውስጥ ያመጣዋል፤ በወይፈኑም ደም እንዳደረገ በፍየሉ ደም ያደርጋል፤ በመክደኛውም ላይና በመክደኛውም ፊት ይረጨዋል።
English: then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering that is for the people and bring his blood within the vail and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat and before the mercy seat.

Amharic: ፅ/ቤቱን በመወከል ከሶስተኛ ወገኖች ጋር ግንኙነት ያደርጋል፡፡።
English: prepare the work programs and budgets of the commission and implement same upon approval.

Amharic: ለተወሰነ ጊዜ የዋና ቢሮውን የተቆጣጠሩትን የኩዴታው አቀናባሪዎች ደውለው የእንኳን ደስ አላችሁ ምኞት የገለፁላቸውን የሰዎች ስም ዝርዝር እየሰበሰበ ነው።
English: and he is collecting the names of those who telephoned the coup-makers to congratulate them during their brief time in control of his headquarters.

Amharic: የሚጨቁኑህን በእጅህ አሳልፎ የሰጠህ።
English: maker of heaven and earth.

Amharic: 8 ያህዌ እያንዳንዱ አገልጋዩ ያለውን አቅም ይመለከታል።
English: 8 yes jehovah notices the potential in each of his servants.

Amharic: አምላክ የመምረጥ ነፃነት በመስጠት አክብሮናል ; ይህን ስጦታ በመጠቀም ከያህዌ ጋር የመጣበቅ እንዲሁም ለእሱ ክብርና ግርማ የማምጣት መብት አለን።
English: god has dignified us with the gift of free will and it is our privilege to use that gift to hold fast to jehovah and to bring him honor and glory as hezekiah did.

Amharic: በሰማያት ያሉትን ብርሃን ሰጪ አካላት ሁሉ ከአንተ የተነሳ አጨልማቸዋለሁ፤ምድርህንም ጨለማ አለብሳለሁ’ ይላል ሉኣላዊው ጌታ ይሆዋ።
English: i will darken all the shining luminaries in the heavens because of you and i will cover your land with darkness ’ declares the sovereign lord jehovah.

Amharic: እነሱም እስኪጠግቡ ድረስ አብረውት በሉ ጠጡም።
English: so they continued banqueting and drinking with him to the full.

Amharic: በወቅቱ የተሰማንን ከፍተኛ ጭንቀትና ስቃይ አሁንም እንኳ መግለፅ ያዳግተኛል።
English: even now i struggle to describe the anguish that we felt.

Amharic: በዚያ ሌሊት አምላክ ለሰለሞን ተገልጦ “እንድሰጥህ የምትፈልገውን ጠይቅ” አለው።
English: that night god appeared to solʹo·mon and said to him: “ask what you would like me to give you.”.

Amharic: ከዚያም አበኔርና ሰዎቹ ሌሊቱን ሙሉ በአረባ ሲጓዙ አደሩ ; ዮርዳኖስንም በመሻገር ሸለቆውን ሁሉ አቋርጠው በመጨረሻ ማሃናይምደረሱ።
English: abner and his men then marched through the arabah all that night and crossed the jordan and marched through the entire ravine and finally came to mahanaim.

Amharic: የሚያሳዝነው ነገር እንዲህ አይነቱን አደጋ ለመከላከል ሲባል ብዙውን ጊዜ እጆቹና እግሮቹ ከተሽከርካሪ ወንበሩ ጋር መታሰር አለባቸው።
English: sadly his arms and legs must often be tied to his wheelchair to prevent such accidents.

Amharic: ከፍ አድርገን ልንመለከተው የሚገባ ውርስ አለን።
English: we have a heritage to be cherished.

Amharic: በሃይል ተንቀጥቅጠው ህይወታቸው ያልፋል።
English: they shake violently and pass away.

Amharic: በተጨማሪም ያቀረበው ፀሎት፣ ልመናው እንዴት እንደተሰማለት፣ የሰራው ሃጢአት ሁሉና ታማኝነት በማጉደል የፈፀመው ድርጊት በባለ ራእዮቹ ዘገባዎች ውስጥ ተካተዋል፤ ደግሞም ራሱን ከማዋረዱ በፊት ከፍ ያሉ የማምለኪያ ቦታዎች የሰራባቸው እንዲሁም የማምለኪያ ግንዶችና የተቀረፁ ምስሎች ያቆመባቸው ስፍራዎች በእነዚህ ዘገባዎች ላይ ተፅፈዋል።
English: also his prayer and how his entreaty was granted him all his sins and his unfaithfulness the locations where he built high places and set up the sacred poles and the graven images before he humbled himself they are written among the words of his visionaries.

Amharic: ከዚያም ለሃጢአት መባ የሚሆነውን በሬ አመጣ ; አሮንና ወንዶች ልጆቹም እጆቻቸውን ለሃጢአት መባ በሚሆነው በሬ ራስ ላይ ጫኑ።
English: then he brought the bull of the sin offering and aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

Amharic: በዚህ አንቀፅ ንኡስ አንቀፅ ፩ መሰረት የተሰጠ ማንኛውም ውሳኔ በጠበቃው የግል ማህደር ውስጥ እንዲመዘገብ ይደረጋል፡፡።
English: cause any decision given in accordance with sub-article 1 of this article to be registered in private file of an advocate.

Amharic: በመሆኑም አቢሴሎም ወደ ንጉሱ ሊልከው ስለፈለገ ኢዮኣብን አስጠራው፤ ኢዮኣብ ግን ወደ እሱ ሳይመጣ ቀረ። ለሁለተኛ ጊዜም ሰው ላከበት፤ እሱ ግን አሁንም ለመምጣት ፈቃደኛ አልሆነም።
English: so abʹsa·lom summoned joʹab in order to send him to the king but joʹab would not come to him. then he sent for him again a second time and he still refused to come.

Amharic: ደግሞም ጦርነት ሆነ፤ ዳዊትም ወጥቶ ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ተዋጋ፥ ታላቅ ግዳይም ገደላቸው፥ ከፊቱም ሸሹ።
English: and there was war again: and david went out and fought with the philistines and slew them with a great slaughter; and they fled from him.

Amharic: በህዝብም መካከል ስለ እርሱ ብዙ ማንጐራጐር ነበረ፤ አንዳንዱም። ደግ ሰው ነው፤ ሌሎች ግን። አይደለም፥ ህዝቡን ግን ያስታል ይሉ ነበር።
English: and there was much murmuring among the people concerning him for some said he is a good man others said nay; but he deceiveth the people.

Amharic: ሃዘን የደረሰባቸው በርካታ ክርስቲያኖች ሌሎችን ለመርዳት አንዳንድ ነገሮችን ማከናወናቸው ከፍተኛ ማፅናኛ እንዳስገኘላቸው ተናግረዋል።
English: many bereaved christians have found that working to help others has brought them great comfort.

Amharic: ወደ ቤት ሲገቡም ህፃኑን ከእናቱ ከማርያም ጋር አዩት ; ተንበርክከውም ሰገዱለት።
English: and when they went into the house they saw the young child with mary his mother and falling down they did obeisance to him.

Amharic: በዚያም የግሪክ ሰው አይሁዳዊም የተገረዘም ያልተገረዘም አረማዊም እስኩቴስም ባሪያም ጨዋ ሰውም መሆን አልተቻለም፥ ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ሁሉ ነው፥ በሁሉም ነው።
English: where there is neither greek nor jew circumcision nor uncircumcision barbarian scythian bond nor free but christ is all and in all.

Amharic: ዝርዝሩ በመመሪያ የሚወሰን ሆኖ ሚኒስቴሩ ወይም አግባብ ያለው ባለስልጣን ከሚመለከ ታቸው አካላት ጋር በመተባበር በዚህ አዋጅ መሰረት ለስራ ውጭ አገር ሄደው ወደ አገራቸው ለሚመለሱ ዜጎች የማቋቋሚያ ድጋፍ ያመቻቻል፡፡።
English: the ministry or the appropriate authority shall in cooperation with concerned bodies facilitate reintegration supports for ethiopian overseas workers deployed and return in accordance with this proclamation; the details of which shall be specified in the directive.

Amharic: 2 ኢየሱስ በማይታይ ሁኔታ የሚገኝበትን ጊዜና የዚህን ስርአት መደምደሚያ አስመልክቶ እንዲህ ብሎ ነበር : በዚያን ጊዜ ከአለም መጀመሪያ አንስቶ እስካሁን ድረስ ሆኖ የማያውቅ ዳግመኛም የማይሆን ታላቅ መከራ ይከሰታል።
English: 2 regarding his invisible presence and the conclusion of the system of things jesus said : there will be great tribulation such as has not occurred since the worlds beginning until now no nor will occur again.

Amharic: ሆኖም በትንሳኤ ከማያምኑት ሰዱቃውያን መካከል አንዳንዶቹ መጥተው ጥያቄ አቀረቡለት : መምህር ሙሴ አንድ ሰው ሚስት አግብቶ ልጅ ሳይወልድ ቢሞት ወንድሙ ሚስትየዋን አግብቶ ለወንድሙ ዘር መተካት አለበት ብሎ ፅፎልናል።
English: however some of the sadducees those who say there is no resurrection came and asked him : teacher moses wrote us if a mans brother dies leaving a wife but he was childless his brother should take the wife and raise up offspring for his brother.

Amharic: ያህዌን መጠጊያ ማድረግ።
English: taking refuge in jehovah.

Amharic: እየተመለሰም ሳለ በሰረገላው ውስጥ ተቀምጦ የነቢዩ ኢሳይያስን መፅሀፍ ድምፁን ከፍ አድርጎ ያነብ ነበር።
English: and he was returning and was sitting in his chariot reading aloud the prophet isaiah.

Amharic: ይህን አንድ ነገር ብቻ አገኘሁ፦ እውነተኛው አምላክ የሰውን ልጆች ቅን አድርጎ ሰራቸው፤ እነሱ ግን ሌላ ብዙ እቅድ አወጡ።”።
English: this alone i have found: the true god made mankind upright but they have sought out many schemes.”.

Amharic: ከንቱ ምናምንቴነትን የጠበቁትን ጠላህ፤ እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሄር ታመንሁ።
English: i have hated them that regard lying vanities: but i trust in the lord.

Amharic: ቅዱሳን መፃህፍት፣ በመጨረሻዎቹ ቀናት በኣለም ላይ የሚኖረው ሁኔታ እጅግ መጥፎ ከመሆኑ የተነሳ ሰዎች መጨረሻው መቅረቡን እንዲያምኑ የሚያደርግ ነገር እንደሚኖር አይገልፁም።
English: thus the scriptures indicate that world conditions during the last days would not become so extreme that people would be forced to believe that the end is near.

Amharic: ሆኖም ሽልማቱን የሚያገኙት ተስፋ ሳይቆርጡ የፀኑ እንደሆኑ አስታውስ።
English: but remember : the prize will go to those who do not give up.

Amharic: “የእጣን ማጨሻዎቹ ቅዱስ ስለሆኑ የካህኑ የአሮን ልጅ አልኣዛር ከእሳቱ ውስጥ እንዲያወጣቸው ንገረው። በተጨማሪም እሳቱን ራቅ አድርጎ እንዲበትነው ንገረው።
English: “tell el·e·aʹzar the son of aaron the priest to take the fire holders out of the fire for they are holy. also tell him to scatter the fire some distance away.

Amharic: ሃሳብ ሲበዛ ቅዠት እንደሚያስከትል የቃላት ብዛት ደግሞ ከንቱነትን ያስከትላልና።
English: for just as many preoccupations lead to dreams so too many words lead to futility.

Amharic: ዳዊት የአሮንን ዘሮችና ሌዋውያኑን ሰበሰበ፦።
English: david gathered the descendants of aaron and the levites.

Amharic: በበአላትሽ ላይ ባለመገኘታቸው ያዘኑትን ሰዎች እሰበስባለሁ።
English: i will gather together those grieving over their absence from your festivals.

Amharic: በሬ ወይም በግ ለመስዋእት ከሚያቀርቡት ህዝብ የካህናቱ ወግ ይህ ይሆናል፤ ወርቹንና ሁለቱን ጉንጮቹን ጨጓራውንም ለካህኑ ይሰጣሉ።
English: and this shall be the priests due from the people from them that offer a sacrifice whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder and the two cheeks and the maw.

Amharic: እባክህ ከዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ያለችውን መልካሚቱን ምድር አዎ ውብ የሆነችውን ይህችን ተራራማ አካባቢና ሊባኖስን ተሻግሬ እንዳይ ፍቀድልኝ።
English: please let me pass over and see the good land that is across the jordan this good mountainous region and lebanon.

Amharic: በእምነታቸው ምሰሏቸው ህልምን የሚፈታው አምላክ አይደለም ? 12።
English: imitate their faith do not interpretations belong to god ? 12.

Amharic: እነሆም፥ የእግዚአብሄርን መኣት በእስራኤል ላይ አብዝታችሁ ትጨምሩ ዘንድ እናንተ የሃጢአተኞች ትውልድ በአባቶቻችሁ ፋንታ ቆማችኋል።
English: and behold ye are risen up in your fathers stead an increase of sinful men to augment yet the fierce anger of the lord toward israel.

Amharic: ዳዊትም የሚሞትበት ቀን ቀረበ፤ ልጁንም ሰሎሞንን እንዲህ ሲል አዘዘው።
English: now the days of david drew nigh that he should die; and he charged solomon his son saying.

Amharic: ከዚህም በላይ ለአምላኬ ቤት ካለኝ ፍቅር የተነሳ ለቅዱሱ ቤት አስቀድሞ ካዘጋጀሁት በተጨማሪ የግል ሀብቴ የሆነውን ወርቅና ብርም ለአምላኬ ቤት እሰጣለሁ፤።
English: moreover because of my delight in the house of my god there is also my private treasure of gold and silver that i am giving to the house of my god in addition to all that i have prepared for the holy house.

Amharic: ይሁን እንጂ እንዲህ ያለ ነፃነት ለማግኘት ወደ ያህዌ መመለስ ይሀውም በግለሰብ ደረጃ ከእሱ ጋር ዝምድና መመስረት ያስፈልገናል።
English: to enjoy and benefit from that freedom however we must turn to jehovah that is come into a personal relationship with him.

Amharic: ማንም ሰው እንዳያልፍባቸው በእሳት ተቃጥለዋልና።
English: for they have been burned up so that no man passes through.

Amharic: ድንገት... ዘራፍ የመምህር አሽከር አለና ልክ እንደቅኔው ዘርፋ እመር ብሎ ተነሳ።
English: all of a sudden... he said i the hero servent of the master and stood up.

Amharic: አድንህ ዘንድ እኔ ከአንተ ጋር ነኝና ይላል ያህዌ።
English: for i am with you declares jehovah to save you.

Amharic: የእስራኤል አምላክ ይሆዋከዘላለም እስከ ዘላለም ይወደስ፤ ህዝቦችም ሁሉ “አሜን!” ይበሉ። ያህን አወድሱ።
English: may jehovah the god of israel be praisedthroughout all eternity. and let all the people say “amen!” praise jah.

Amharic: የአፍንጫ ቀለበቱንና አምባሮቹን በእህቱ እጆች ላይ ሲመለከት እንዲሁም እህቱ ርብቃ “ሰውየው እንዲህ እንዲህ አለኝ” ብላ ስትናገር ሲሰማ በምንጩ አጠገብ ከግመሎቹ ጋር ቆሞ የነበረውን ሰው ለማግኘት ወደ እሱ ሄደ።
English: when he saw the nose ring and the bracelets on the hands of his sister and heard the words of his sister re·bekʹah who was saying “this is the way the man spoke to me ” he came to meet the man who was still there standing by the camels at the spring.

English: you will fear calamity no more.

English: now after the death of moses the servant of the lord it came to pass that the lord spake unto joshua the son of nun moses minister saying.

English: the fact that some people have auto accidents does not make it wrong to drive a car.

English: i asked myself who could have orchestrated the writing of this unified masterpiece ? the only reasonable answer is god.

English: gotta say that this shocked me i have always thought mr. baker was a upstanding guy but this is just plain good old fashioned bullcrap.

Amharic: የሰው ልጆች የወደፊቱን ጊዜ የማወቅ ችሎታ ባይኖረንም ልንወስደው ያሰብነው እርምጃ ምን ውጤት እንደሚያስከትል አስቀድመን ማሰባችን ተገቢ ነው።
English: we do not have that degree of foresight but we do well to think about what could happen as a result of what we are about to do.

Amharic: በመለኪያ ገመድም ርስት አከፋፈላቸው።
English: he allotted to them an inheritance by the measuring line.

Amharic: እነሱም ከዚያ ወጥተው ሰዎች ንስሀ ይገቡ ዘንድ ሰበኩ፤።
English: then they set out and preached that people should repent.

Amharic: ከሻእቢያ ጋር የተካሄደውን ውጊያ የመራነው እኛ ነን።
English: we are the one who led the battle against eplf.

English: so i associated with an evangelical religion for a time.

Amharic: ያም በፊት ይግገዙት የነበሩት ከእነርሱ ይጠፋቸዋል፡፡ ለእነርሱም ምንም መሸሻ የሌላቸው መሆኑን ያረጋግጣሉ፡፡።
English: and lost from them will be those they were invoking before and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.

Amharic: ይህንም ብሎ እንጀራን ይዞ በሁሉ ፊት እግዚአብሄርን አመሰገነ ቈርሶም ይበላ ዘንድ ጀመረ።
English: and when he had thus spoken he took bread and gave thanks to god in presence of them all and when he had broken it he began to eat.

English: i was desperately lonely.

English: apparently though barnabas saw past marks inconsistent behavior and later seized the opportunity to complete his training.

English: your affirmative answers served as a public declaration of your unreserved dedication and showed that you were qualified for baptism as an ordained minister of jehovah.
